rows.text: Please stand by, passengers. The navigation meeting will be starting soon!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: She doesn't think it's right to join in on our vote when she's only hitchhiking with us, so she's waiting in the Party Car.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I'm sure everyone has a destination in mind.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: He isn't joining us for the navigation meeting. He went to the Party Car to rest.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I can't decide if he'll be happy or disappointed to hear that.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Your words, not mine.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Since everyone's here, Pom-Pom will start presenting our options. First up is the oceanic planet of Lushaka.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: It's not that simple. But we can save Pom-Pom from worrying about service delays, at least for a foreseeable period of time.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: They suffered an ambush by the Antimatter Legion some time ago. According to the IPC, the enemy was repelled, but Edo Star placed their planet on temporary lockdown. I'm afraid there's nothing we can do there.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Geez, stop messing around. We don't need a scrub. The Express is already spotlessly clean.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Amphoreus does have something to offer, unlike the other options...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: (I'd better start packing up, too. Or should I go chat some more with the others?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Ah, [Trailblazer]. This is your first time exploring beyond the astral charts, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It doesn't feel any different to me...
I can't provide many details about our destination this time. You can ask the Memokeeper if you want to know more.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Are you nervous, Dan Heng?
Oh ho, the data bank's getting a huge update.
Why do you ask that? Are you feeling nervous yourself? It'll be fine. Just trust the Crew.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Mhm, I suppose there's a lot to do. I'll disembark with all of you this time.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We've never had this many passengers on board before... I'm still not used to it. Why don't you head to the Party Car first? I'll see you later.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Same for everyone else, right?
Are credits going to be useless there?
Worlds that have been mapped on the astral charts also present new surprises from time to time.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Maybe not for Pom-Pom. And worlds that have been mapped on the astral charts also present new surprises from time to time.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That's quite the detail to fixate on. Perhaps you should be worrying about language barriers instead?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But we'll be fine. Let's just say I have a backup plan. I'll reveal it when the time comes.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: A world yet to be explored by the Trailblaze... No self-respecting Nameless would turn that opportunity down.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: An opportunity hard to come by?
Hah! So I'm better than an Aeon!
Absolutely. The Astral Express has always traveled along the silver rail laid down by Akivili. We don't normally get to venture into a world beyond the knowledge of the Trailblaze.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: This is Akivili we're talking about. In the first instance, every one of THEIR stops was a world no human had ever set foot on. The Astral Express has always traveled along the silver rail laid down by Akivili, so we don't normally get to venture into a world beyond the knowledge of the Trailblaze.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: But this time, we might just get the chance to add a brand-new stop to the astral charts. I don't mind telling you — I'm a little excited.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Hey, great timing! I just turned on my camera and was looking through some old photos.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Can I ask you something? What's your favorite part of a journey, from start to finish?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The start of a journey, when we dive into the unknown.
The middle of the journey, when some gains are made.
The end of the journey, when we wanna commemorate the adventure.
Then let's go snap some photos as soon as we arrive in Amphoreus!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Then you're going to have to give me a nudge whenever there's something worth snapping!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Me too! This time in Amphoreus let's make sure we get a group photo that everyone loves!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The landing car is ready. My dear trailblazing vanguards, are you all set to dive into the unknown?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I'm ready.
Hold on a moment.
Go ahead and journey into The Eternal Land!
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Oh? Need to psyche yourself up? Don't keep us waiting too long.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Anyway, enough chitchat! I better pack some extra batteries in case we end up somewhere without power!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I am a Memokeeper, after all. Memories don't lie.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Truth be told, it's more of a personal request.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "Memokeepers traverse the worlds only to collect precious memories." Have you heard that before?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Looks like you've decided on your next stop?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: We're going to Amphoreus.
We're going to a Washtopia.
We're going back to Penacony.
That's unexpected, alright... but let's not do that.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Laid-back? That's... not exactly a word I associate with him.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I see.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: That's unexpected, alright... but let's not do that.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Laid-back? That's... not exactly a word I associate with him.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: You're taking it very calmly.
No comment from you?
Those who embark on a long journey simply need to "set off."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Attention, passengers. The Express is about to make the jump. Please be seated and hold on!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Here it is — the isolated world that can only be seen through the Garden's mirror...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The Eternal Land, Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: No one knows. That's what you're about to find out.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I used a little magic so all of you can also see what it looks like.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: As you can see, Amphoreus is surrounded by a mass of chaotic matter that conceals it from the outside world — nearly. Conventional interstellar travel can't detect its presence, let alone pass by or land on the planet.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Yet the Garden, caught a glimpse of this place, and along with it, discovered ever-shifting Traces.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "Three Paths interweave and fetter Amphoreus, co-authoring the fate of the world." Ordinary Pathstriders aren't known to leave traces in the mirror, so if what you said is true...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Then this isolated star system must be home to at least three beings comparable to Emanators.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I would even go as far as to say Aeons THEMSELVES.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: For a world to have nurtured such marvels yet still remain unheard of throughout the cosmos? Now, that is hard to fathom.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: We already know one of the three Paths to be the Erudition...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I can reveal the second. In fact, you've all seen it just now. It's the Remembrance.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I see. Then it makes sense that a messenger of the Garden would be capable of unveiling Amphoreus for us. What about the final Path?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Unfortunately, fate is keeping the third Path a mystery. I don't know what it is, either.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Hidden beneath the brilliance of Erudition and Remembrance, yet possessing enough power to rival the other two Paths. It could be the Equilibrium, the Enigmata, or perhaps the Permanence? I have no clue at all.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: This white ribbon of light encircling Amphoreus might very well be a product of the three interwoven Paths. Only when Pathstriders of the Trailblaze enter the center of the vortex will its true nature be revealed.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Still, we know far too little about the planet.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What's more pressing is finding a suitable landing site. We could end up over an ocean, in a vacuum without oxygen, or worse yet, in the middle of a lava field...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It is. Still, encountering worlds that exist which are not recorded in the data bank is unavoidable.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I know you're fearless even in the face of death, but don't act recklessly. Everyone values you.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Throwing in the towel already? I don't think we're at that point yet.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Looks like someone is all set and itching to get off the train.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...Wait, I think we might be missing someone.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Very funny... But seriously, where's March 7th?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: She said something about her camera before going back to her room. I haven't seen her since the warp.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That's not like March. She's usually the most excited about expeditions. Let's drop by her room.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: March, are you in here?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Yeah...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Sorry, guys. I don't know what's wrong... I just feel really weak after the warp...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I doubt it...? Pretty girls aren't supposed to get sick...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Of course not! I've been through way more jumps than you ever have!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Have a heart, will you? Stop scaring me...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Miss Black Swan, could you take a look at the memories in this room?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Gladly.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...I'm seeing March 7th hit by a sudden bout of weakness in her memories, as if something was weighing on her. The onset of it far too quick to be any kind of sickness.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Perhaps it's the effect of some external stimulus?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Ahh, why is everyone here!? I should've cleaned my room...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I invited Sunday to help with the diagnosis. He grew up in a star system rich in memoria. When it comes to mental healing, he's quite the specialist.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: You've all been to Penacony before. I presume you are aware of how some might find themselves in a Synesthesia Dreamscape after warping to Asdana.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I'm guessing this is something similar. Miss March appears to be affected by a certain external stimulus, perhaps a Path, an Aeon, or even... Amphoreus itself.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I agree. That's likely the case.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Why is she the only one affected?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: There's no way to tell at this point. It could just be a matter of time before everyone feels unwell.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Before we identify the cause, my suggestion is for Miss March to avoid venturing anywhere near Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: It's okay, Himeko. I'll be good on my own. Go ahead, guys! I'll catch up once I feel better...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Here, [Trailblazer]. Take my camera along! I was planning to take photos when we got there, but looks like you'll have to help me with that now...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Heh, I know I can always count on you.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Haha, what's with the melodramatic turn... I'll be fine.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: No—! Not when my hair's messy. And don't drain the camera's battery now...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Why don't we take our discussion outside so March 7th can rest?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Yeah, you guys go on ahead. Don't worry about me! I'll be back to being my hyperactive and adorable self by the next time you see me. Now don't forget about those photos, okay? I'll be checking the camera!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh, I almost forgot. I was looking at the photos from before when I realized something. When we were on Jarilo-VI, the Xianzhou, and Penacony...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The first local we met in each of those worlds all harbored their own deep secret! I'm sure it'll be the same on Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I can't join you guys this time, but make sure to always look out for one another, okay...?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Do you think March 7th's past could be connected to Amphoreus?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: No, that'd be too much of a coincidence. I haven't seen anything related to Six-Phased Ice yet. It's more likely that some kind of energy on Amphoreus affected her before any of us.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Black Swan presses her forehead against March 7th's head, as if feeling the latter's body temperature...
[Trailblazer], I want you and Dan Heng to take the lead in this trailblazing expedition. Are you up for it?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I see our adventure in Penacony has helped [Trailblazer] grow into an experienced Nameless.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Not to worry, we have a knack for finding trustworthy friends wherever we go.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Amphoreus is a crucial stop, so everyone on the Express has been roped in to help in some way or another. Venturing into the unknown world is a task perfect for you youngsters. I'm sure you'll both have each other's backs.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: So we're... staying behind to take care of the grownup stuff?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Chin up, Welt. You'll get your chance out in the field.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Someone should be taking care of March 7th, too. I can do that.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I'm fine with any arrangement you have for me.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Great, sounds like we're all good! Come with me to the Parlor Car then, you two.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I prepared a backup plan before our departure, but I didn't count on having to reveal it so soon.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Amphoreus is outside the Interastral Peace Communications' coverage zone, so there's no chance of remote communication when you're there.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Only in extenuating circumstances~! Don't go thinking you can detach cars from the Express every which way, alright!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Oh, no you don't! Only in extenuating circumstances! Don't go thinking you can detach cars from the Express every which way, alright!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Get going whenever you're ready. Pom-Pom can't wait to hear about your exciting discoveries!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Oof...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...Dan Heng?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...Sorry for what?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Ugh... How long were we out for?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I guessed as much... It's no longer working. Looks like it's just the two of us out here now.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Let's find someplace safe to set up a base of operations first. This statue and the buildings we've seen so far point to a civilization here on Amphoreus...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We can only hope that they're not hostile toward outsiders.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...Someone's here? Ready your weapon and stay alert.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Let's find out what's behind that gate.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A giant sphere stands between heaven and earth in the distance. At its top, the sky appears torn open — or rather, it seems to have willingly opened a circular rift. Inside, a swirling vortex churns, and the clouds periodically reflect a golden glow.

If March 7th were here, she'd definitely use her girlish imagination to come up with some whimsical and creative metaphors for the scenery. Unfortunately, it's up to you to take on the team's photographer duties now.
Hold on. It opened on its own?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Across the cliff, the grand palace gates remain silent, unwilling to reveal any of the history and secrets hidden behind it.
What could lie within the gate? You can't help but let your imagination run wild: Bloody carnage, chaotic banquets, bottomless abyss...
Then you regain focus, hearing a playful voice softly whisper in your ear—
Why is it so dark? Is it nighttime already...?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...Wha?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Over there. That pink thing.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You see it, too?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Yes, it's not an illusion.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: There it is again. Is it doing all of this? This phenomenon... is hard to explain.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's gone... That happened too fast for us to make any sense of it. Did you see what the creature looked like?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's unlike any of the known species in our data bank. But I guess that's to be expected. We know nothing about Amphoreus, after all.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Back when we were trailblazing into Jarilo-VI, we knew its history and terrain even before arriving on the planet. But with Amphoreus... All we have is whatever little Black Swan told us about the world.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'm afraid we must plan for the worst. Putting a potential language barrier aside, that was a powerful attack on us just now... It's hard to imagine a planet as far out and isolated as this having the expertise to create such sophisticated weaponry.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I can't tell for sure. But let's not get our hopes up too high. We can learn and observe as we move.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hmm, now that's one monumental city gate.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Imposing and somewhat archaic... Could it be a cultural site?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Well, it looks like no one lives in this area, and that strange creature from before is nowhere to be seen. But...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Look at that.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Judging from the prevalence of these colossal structures, this civilization has more than just great engineers and architects. The structures also indicate a universal belief system. If only it were closer, I'd be able to make out the details.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Lord Phainon! May Kephale bless you!
rows.speaker: Holy City Guard 1

rows.text: Don't be rash! Protect the citizens first!
rows.speaker: Holy City Guard 1

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}, please answer our calls...
rows.speaker: Okhema Refugee 1

rows.text: Chrysos Heirs, please protect us...
rows.speaker: Okhema Refugee 1

rows.text: The prophecy of Lady Trinnon has come true...
rows.speaker: Holy City Guard 2

rows.text: Victory belongs to Okhema!
rows.speaker: Holy City Guard 2

rows.text: Curse you, {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}!
rows.speaker: Okhema Refugee 2

rows.text: Okhema shall forever despise you!
rows.speaker: Okhema Refugee 2

rows.text: Stay calm, hold formation!
rows.speaker: Holy City Guard 3

rows.text: Wait for Lady Aglaea's orders!
rows.speaker: Holy City Guard 3

rows.text: Don't panic. Retreat according to the plan.
rows.speaker: Okhema Refugee 3

rows.text: We mustn't cause more trouble for the heroes.
rows.speaker: Okhema Refugee 3

rows.text: Servant of Thanatos...
rows.speaker: Celestial Monster

rows.text: Keep away from her...
rows.speaker: Celestial Monster

rows.text: A death without glory is no...
rows.speaker: Celestial Monster

rows.text: It's the smell of the River of Souls...
rows.speaker: Celestial Monster

rows.text: Shadow of Death... Begone...
rows.speaker: Celestial Monster

rows.text: No need to fear... No need to cower...
rows.speaker: Calm Refugee

rows.text: The hero from the prophecy will sweep away the shadows of fate, and Kephale's light will always protect Okhema...
rows.speaker: Calm Refugee

rows.text: The chilling aura emanating from Castorice fills you with unease. In the depths of your mind, it feels as though an overwhelming darkness is about to engulf you...
Now isn't the time to take risks. Maybe you should have followed her advice and kept a safe distance.
...If you want to take some photos, now would be the perfect time.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Photograph the distant giant sphere.
Hellooo~! Snap out of it and click the shutter already!
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: Photograph the cliffside gate.
These things aren't breathing. ...Inorganic lifeforms?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Let's do this.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: When will days like these finally come to an end...
rows.speaker: Panicked Refugee

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Passage Titan}Janus{RUBY_E#}, if only you were still here with us...
rows.speaker: Calm Refugee

rows.text: ...Titan, please bless my people...
rows.speaker: Panicked Refugee

rows.text: Hang on, you'll be able to leave soon
rows.speaker: Calm Refugee

rows.text: I can't walk anymore.
rows.speaker: Calm Refugee

rows.text: Rest up. There will be a way out of this.
rows.speaker: Calm Refugee

rows.text: Have hope, child...
rows.speaker: Calm Refugee

rows.text: Will Janus... show us the future?
rows.speaker: Calm Refugee

rows.text: Save us, Gate of Infinity...
rows.speaker: Panicked Refugee

rows.text: I bear no harm. I just want everyone to be safe.
rows.speaker: White-haired Youth

rows.text: Everyone to be safe?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Roaming around a place like the Abyss with weapons in tow is a show of provocation. Those soldiers are minions of the Strife Titan. They're not known to stop until all invaders fall under their feet.
rows.speaker: White-haired Youth

rows.text: If you continue brandishing your weapons, you won't only be putting yourselves in the crossfire...
rows.speaker: White-haired Youth

rows.text: Their looming blades will come down on the heads of the innocent.
rows.speaker: White-haired Youth

rows.text: "Ena the Order emerged, destined to restore all existence."
May Janus reveal our road.
rows.speaker: Panicked Refugee

rows.text: When will this end...?
rows.speaker: Panicked Refugee

rows.text: The temple is so cold...
rows.speaker: Calm Refugee

rows.text: Where will fate take us...?
rows.speaker: Panicked Refugee

rows.text: We can finally get out of here!
rows.speaker: Panicked Refugee

rows.text: Hopefully, Okhema is a safe place.
rows.speaker: Calm Refugee

rows.text: O gods, please have mercy on our destiny...
rows.speaker: Panicked Refugee

rows.text: A civil approach gets your message across all the same.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's difficult to tell if you're friend or foe when you appear out of thin air. Even without your weapons, a great power still lurks within you...
rows.speaker: White-haired Youth

rows.text: I could be putting myself in harm's way for all I know. I'd be unwise not to take precautions.
rows.speaker: White-haired Youth

rows.text: So, care to share the reason for dropping in on us? Hmm? Visitors from above?
rows.speaker: White-haired Youth

rows.text: Phai—non—! Look what you did again! Taking off only to get yourself into trouble?
rows.speaker: Young Female Voice

rows.text: Wait— you see Dan Heng's chest rising and falling, proof that life still lingers within him.
...He doesn't even twitch. Looks like you gotta try some new ideas.
You recall the moment you first met Dan Heng and March 7th...
You suddenly felt the urge to "slap him" for no reason — There are no grudges. Some thoughts just spontaneously appear like that.
How can such a thought even cross your mind? You're scared... You feel like slapping yourself to snap out of it!
It's as if someone is shouting in your ear: "JUST DO IT!" It's veritably the whispers of the devil. After much hesitation, you finally lean down and...
Agh, you even ruined his weapon! Now you've really gone and done it! This is no way to be treating strangers.
rows.speaker: Red-haired Girl

rows.text: I was just trying to fix our problem in the safest way possible.
rows.speaker: White-haired Youth

rows.text: Me...
How is this safe!? Hello, friendly strangers! Let's all simmer down and cool our jets. We're all humans here. No need for things to get so heated.
rows.speaker: Red-haired Girl

rows.text: Snowy's just worried you're baddies from above, but we know you two are nothing of the sort! Oh right, you don't know us yet. We are Tribbie from Janusopolis, and this is... Snowy! Hurry up and apologize to them!
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Alright, if you say so, Tribbie... I apologize for my earlier behavior. I was overly wary because both of you landed in this tumultuous region, it put me on high alert.
rows.speaker: White-haired Youth

rows.text: I understand. We're Trailblazers from beyond the sky.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: There is no point concealing anything. They saw everything. If they wanted us dead, they wouldn't be standing around talking to us.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...Not from above the sky but beyond it...?
rows.speaker: White-haired Youth

rows.text: Wow, that's something else altogether... You're lucky you met us, then.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: She means you're lucky because we won't hurt you, but the same can't be said for others.
rows.speaker: White-haired Youth

rows.text: ...Let's talk somewhere else. You've seen it first-hand. It isn't safe out here. As you saw, there are still many refugees who haven't been freed in the temple.
rows.speaker: White-haired Youth

rows.text: We're here to rescue and escort them to the holy city, Okhema. They're the reason I had to be absolutely sure you were not here with ill intent, and why I wanted you to put away your weapons. If something were to occur, they would have no way of protecting themselves.
rows.speaker: White-haired Youth

rows.text: I'm Phainon from Aedes Elysiae. Sorry if I offended you just now.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...You sound disappointed.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Friction really does spark friendships, huh? Here, you can have your weapon back.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I'm Dan Heng. This is—
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That sounds mighty impressive, but I'm guessing it's a nickname? We're meeting each other for the first time, so shouldn't you tell me your actual name?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Baseball bat? Oh, you mean this marvel of a weapon...? Sorry, but why don't you tell me your name in return for your weapon?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Friction really does spark friendships, huh? Here, you can have your weapon back.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Friction really does spark friendships, huh?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Well how about that? Perhaps it's fate! Friction really does spark friendships, huh? Here, you can have your weapon back.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: And here's your spear. Don't worry, this is entirely on Snowy. I'll make sure he fixes it for you!
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Ahaha... It seems I'll have to treat Chartonus to a couple of drinks again.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We've just arrived and still have many questions. If you two can ensure our safety, traveling together would certainly be the best choice.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Please lead the way.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: How do you view the situation?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I agree. To disarm you in a flash and even snap my spear... He's no ordinary person.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: He was also quite cautious, keeping his distance throughout the conversation. I tried probing for more information on Amphoreus, but they both casually glossed over it.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Conversely, I believe this indicates he doesn't believe he can easily subdue us. If things take a turn for the worse, our best bet is still going to be resolution by force.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Yes, the timing is suspect, too. The spear that destroyed our car is definitely man-made.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I suspected they might have staged the encounter, but these refugees... they're clearly not pretending. For now, it's reasonable to assume they're not on the same side as the attackers.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I've been trying to come up with possible theories for that, though the answer still eludes me. Perhaps like Jarilo-VI, Amphoreus was served by the silver rail eons ago? But the data bank would at least have some record on the planet if it were true...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The way the girl uses "we" and "us" to refer to herself is unusual, too. I doubt it's just a habit of speech.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: But compared with our other suspicions, sharing a common language is the least of our concerns right now. As the saying goes, let's get moving like a blade through... You get the point.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Though losing the spear is unfortunate, we gained some important insight: Amphoreus' weapon-forging skills are on par with the craftsmanship that forged Cloud-Piercer.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Looks like this world is nowhere near as primitive as we had first thought. Perhaps they have more to surprise us with at this "holy city" they mentioned.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Is someone arguing in the temple? Let's take a look, and remember... keep it friendly.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: No, I will never agree to that...
rows.speaker: Elder

rows.text: Virtus! You acted on your own to ask the Chrysos Heirs for help!? To bring us into their so-called holy city, no less! We are priests of {RUBY_B#Passage Titan}Janus{RUBY_E#}, born as footless birds — how could we possibly endure being confined to one place?
rows.speaker: Elder

rows.text: You see all the white shells jutting out from the dromas' limbs and plan to use them as footholds...
We've lost far too many to {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}'s forces, Mr. Noldus! I only want for everyone to settle down somewhere safe, and to be able to sleep soundly.
rows.speaker: Virtus

rows.text: Lose your faith, and you lose everything. Do you seriously think you can seek shelter in Okhema? Nowhere is safe with the end times looming!
rows.speaker: Noldus

rows.text: I've said my piece. Leave, if that's what you want. Everyone else is staying in this temple, where we enjoy the protection of {RUBY_B#Passage Titan}Janus, the Gate of Infinity{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Noldus

rows.text: Don't make this decision in haste, sir—
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I appreciate the concern, esteemed Chrysos Heir. But please respect that we have the right to choose our own fate.
rows.speaker: Noldus

rows.text: I'm sorry you had to see that, esteemed Chrysos Heir. Hmm? These two with you are...?
rows.speaker: Virtus

rows.text: Travelers from afar. They're also headed for the holy city. If memory serves me right, you are... Virtus? Please, you may call me Phainon. What was that just now?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: What {F#she}{M#he} meant to say is: We can help.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's an honor you remember me, Phainon. We are priests from Janusopolis. Armies of the Strife Titan destroyed our home, forcing us to flee across many lands until we arrived here.
rows.speaker: Virtus

rows.text: A few days ago, I watched another companion fall to those monsters, and I was shattered... I offered a prayer to Okhema, thinking the answer would take time, at least enough for me to convince Mr. Noldus. I didn't expect your arrival to be so swift...
rows.speaker: Virtus

rows.text: Is that not also strange?
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Is that not also strange?
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: No idea what you're saying...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The elder spoke of the "end times" just now and claimed that no place in Amphoreus is safe. What did he mean by that...?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Excuse me, sir? Everyone knows about the prophecy. How is it that you—
rows.speaker: Virtus

rows.text: Virtus, right now we must focus on convincing Mr. Noldus to return. The Abyss is swarming with fierce enemies, and they have no way to defend themselves, leaving them vulnerable to all kinds of danger.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: My friends, I have a rather bold request. The two of you are quite capable — might I trouble you to fetch Mr. Noldus?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Tribbie will join you. She can also answer any questions you may have.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Please give us a moment to discuss it.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Phainon interrupted me as I was trying to gather information from that refugee, and now he's saying the girl will answer our questions. His intent is obvious.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: No.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Yes.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I believe he thinks it's worse for others to find out we know nothing about this world. He wants to hide the fact that we're visitors from beyond the sky.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: There's a rift between us and the locals, so let's play along with Phainon for now. We can also learn what Tribbie thinks when we're alone with her.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Alright, we'll go. If we're to be companions on this journey, it's only right that we offer assistance where possible.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You two are truly honorable! I'll stay behind to guard Virtus and the rest. Go quickly and come back safe.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I'm sure you two have a ton of questions, don't you?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: As for why we should speak in private, that's because quiet places are better suited for communicating with one another.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: But the road ahead is... cut off.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What are you talking about...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What is it?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Heh. Judging by your reactions, you weren't lying about being newly arrived travelers. In that case, don't blink, or you'll miss the next part.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Also, Snowy wouldn't dare make plans for us. It's more like the other way around!
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Alright! Silence, please. We are about to summon a miracle...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "We, thy humble descendants, doth surmount the myriad of passages of {RUBY_B#Passage Titan}Janus{RUBY_E#} to stand before thee and receive the scales of judgment."
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "O, selfless arbiter {RUBY_B#Law Titan}Talanton{RUBY_E#}, declare us innocent in the name of the law. Weigh the fruits of the present in exchange for the sweetness of the past."
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "We summon thee, {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}, to lift thy curtain of memory..."
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: H—How is that possible... Did {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx's{RUBY_E#} prayer fail?
rows.speaker: Panicked Refugee

rows.text: My two friends, don't stray too far away from us!
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Stop panicking! As long as we're with them, we'll be fine.
rows.speaker: Calm Refugee

rows.text: Amazing, isn't it? Now that we're here, we can speak in peace...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Huh? But why does it feel a little too quiet?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Just what I was afraid of. So much for a peaceful chat...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: The history lesson will have to wait, my friends. We must help Mr. Noldus!
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Whew... Thank you. The three of you saved our lives.
rows.speaker: Noldus

rows.text: Mr. Noldus, Virtus was right. It's too dangerous for all of you to be here. Please come back to Okhema with us.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: I believe I've made my stance clear, my child. Us priests would rather die in the pursuit of faith than live in a foreign land.
rows.speaker: Noldus

rows.text: Sir, we deeply understand your faith in the Titans. Perhaps in your eyes, {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#}, the protector of the holy city, is but a god from a foreign land.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: But we swear to you in the name of {RUBY_B#Passage Titan}Janus,{RUBY_E#} the Gate of Infinity that so long as the Chrysos Heirs live, Okhema will protect all followers of the Titans. We are one and the same.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: You swear in the name of {RUBY_B#Passage Titan}Janus{RUBY_E#}? Who are you...
rows.speaker: Noldus

rows.text: Don't you remember, Noldus?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Our name is Tribios.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: What? You're the high priest!?
rows.speaker: Noldus

rows.text: What do you mean?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Why do you look like a child? No, to think that I, a mere tribal priest, dared lecture you on faith. How ludicrous! Please forgive my transgressions...
rows.speaker: Noldus

rows.text: Noldus, we do not wish to force you, but please think of the people in your tribe.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: The young place their trust in you just as you place your trust in us. If you stay, they will remain here too, doomed to fall under {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}'s spear.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: If that is "divine will," then I have no reason to disobey.
rows.speaker: Noldus

rows.text: High priest, please guide us once again as we spread our wings on this long journey.
rows.speaker: Noldus

rows.text: Mr. Noldus, I'm glad you're all right.
rows.speaker: Virtus

rows.text: Virtus, I still disagree with your methods, but it doesn't matter now. Let us place our trust in the Chrysos Heirs.
rows.speaker: Noldus

rows.text: The dromas caravan that's supposed to meet us isn't here yet, so let's all rest where it's safe for a while.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Regrettably, our questions are still unanswered, and now we have even more. Now that things have calmed down, perhaps you two can find the time to answer a few of them?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Of course. Please come this way.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I see you've both been made aware of our troubles. I'm grateful for your understanding, so in return, please ask me anything you wish to know.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Just as the word implies, it's the time of strife before the world meets its end.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Are you saying your civilization is coming to an end?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: To be precise, it's the whole world that's coming to an end.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The ancient gods of Amphoreus, once worshiped by humanity, they now stand as their foes.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The prophetic Deliverers, with golden blood coursing through their veins.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It's a gift from the Three Titans of Fate. With their blessings, priests can awaken shadows of the past to alter reality.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You're putting it too lightly. Don't make miracles sound like a tool you can simply use at will.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Your answers are too concise...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'm sorry. I guess I'm not good at telling stories.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Yet, a tedious and overly long explanation isn't ideal either. Let me think...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Right! Virtus and the others are priests from Janusopolis. They should be adept at playing the lyre. How about playing a song for our two friends?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: There's a ballad that's been passed down in Amphoreus since ancient times...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "Happiness abound in this lush land by gods chosen. Giants raised their glasses in a toast beheld by the twelve constellations."
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "Three carved the heavens and the earth, three wove the threads of fate. Three molded life with their hands, and three guided calamity's gate."
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "They declared the world too unstirring, hence wished endless laughter upon the living."
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "Thus you and I were created, with words and song to weave, and love and intimacy to give."
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "Thus, creation was complete, who then will bear the weight of humanity's souls, to lighten the steps of the living as a whole?"
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "O great {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#}, all-knowing father of stature so tall, yet low does their gaze willingly fall."
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "With light of dawn heavy upon their shoulders, golden ichor spills unto the land..."
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "...forming the boiling river that flows through the legacies of heroes who take their stand..."
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: ...Hmm?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Hahaha! Don't worry. That's just our rescue. Time to get up, everyone!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I forgot to mention. Don't touch their white stone humps. When the Earth Titan blessed these creatures, it's said they also stuffed their ill tempers into these humps.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: See? Easy, wasn't it?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Suffering's bad for your health, and it won't help your faith much, either. That's why it's our inherent duty as Chrysos Heirs to free everyone from suffering.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You both fought so bravely. Are you Chrysos Heirs from a foreign land?
rows.speaker: Attacked Citizen

rows.text: Please, I beg of you! Save Okhema! The mad king {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} has returned! Look! There's strife and conflict everywhere...
rows.speaker: Attacked Citizen

rows.text: Stay calm and leave this to us. You must hurry and find shelter.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Thank you, thank you... Your comrades are fighting inside the city. Fate will guide you to them.
rows.speaker: Attacked Citizen

rows.text: I expected the holy city to be a strong sanctuary, but things are less peaceful than I thought. Let's stay here and lend our support on the battlefield.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: They're just minions. My cloudhymn magic will be sufficient.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "The Deliverers mentioned in the prophecy"... It seems the people have a lot of faith in Phainon and the others.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I don't think so. These Titankin have obvious differences to the Antimatter Legion.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Our priority now is to find Phainon.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The main road's been blocked off! Tribbie...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Don't panic. Leave this to us! "I summon thee, {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}!"
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "...Lift the curtain and stir up ripples of past reverie!"
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: How's the situation?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's you two... I'm sorry we got you involved again.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I never expected {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} to lead an army and launch a surprise attack on the holy city at a time like this... They and {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#} have always been mortal enemies, but now they've gone mad like a vicious beast.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You have my gratitude. Thankfully, Okhema is not completely unprepared. The prophecy had warned us about this. This is a catastrophe, but it's not the end.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: There's no need to panic. Okhema is not completely unprepared. The prophecy had warned us about this. This is a catastrophe, but it's not the end.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Mr. Noldus and the others have gone to seek shelter. Leave the rest to us. You should evacuate along with the citizens.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: I don't doubt your skills but...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Very well, but please remain by my side. These pests can't hurt you, but our companions, those known as the "Chrysos Heirs"...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Their attacks do not discriminate between friend and foe.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: O {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#}, Throne of Worlds, please end your long silence and grant humanity protection...
rows.speaker: Pious Citizen

rows.text: What are you doing? It's not safe here. Seek shelter, quickly!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: No, no, no, it's very safe here.
rows.speaker: Stubborn Citizen

rows.text: The prophecy has already revealed that the light of {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#} will shine upon all...
rows.speaker: Pious Citizen

rows.text: Watch! No one will die. The heroes will protect the city!
rows.speaker: Stubborn Citizen

rows.text: Leave them be. Just as Mr. Noldus reveres {RUBY_B#Passage Titan}Janus{RUBY_E#}, faith is all some people have left in a world teetering on the brink of collapse.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: To honor their faith is the sacred duty of the Chrysos Heirs— Minions of Strife, you shall not harm these people!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Bodies everywhere. How could so many enemies have made it to the front gates? Where were the city guards?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Snowy...
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: We're back.
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: We are Trianne!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: We are Trinnon!
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: We are Tribbie— Wait, no, now is not the time for introductions!
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: ...The surprises never cease in Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Snowy, De has been trading blows with the main forces for what feels like forever, from the skies to the city! Hurry up and assist him!
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: I knew it... He gets reckless once he gets the urge to kill. I'm relying on you three to handle the task of getting the citizens to safety.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Don't worry! With us here, we can just use the Century Gate to whoosh the people to the safest place in Amphoreus—
rows.speaker: Trianne

rows.text: Wouldn't that be Okhema?
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: Stop messing around and help the people! Anywhere is fine, just send them to somewhere safe!
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Don't worry. Although they are a little childish, the trio are experienced Chrysos Heirs and one of the pillars of Okhema. Therefore, they can definitely be trusted.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Well, let's keep on moving then.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: L—Lord Phainon! You're finally here. Quick, save the Grand Craftsman! He's surrounded by enemies—
rows.speaker: Startled Citizen

rows.text: What!?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Chartonus! Hang in there!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Chartonus!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Phainon...
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: I'm glad that you're okay...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: As for you, Mydei... If I'm not mistaken, shouldn't your responsibility be protecting the citizens?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: What is that supposed to mean? Who are you implying isn't a citizen here?
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Don't evade the question. Aglaea told us to protect the citizens. Are you ignoring what she said?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It is you who forget the second half of her words. Her original words were, "Protect the citizens and eliminate the invaders." The crisis in the holy city will be resolved once we've eliminated {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Speaking of which, since you've never considered the pair over there to be "citizens"...
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: They seem to fit the definition of "invaders."
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Trinnon, Tribbie, Trianne}The three priests of Janus{RUBY_E#} share the same appearance and mind, and their senses are also interlinked. The Okhemans have long been aware of your presence and what you have been doing.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: You trust him that much? I suggest you think twice.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Provoking your allies at such a critical juncture. Whose side are you on?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: From the moment we first met, I already told you that regardless of whether it's in the past or in the future, the people of Kremnos will never agree to make peace with the likes of you...
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: As the successor of Kremnos, I, Mydei, am not able to act independently on such matters. Furthermore, things have escalated to a point where I must warn you, esteemed guests, that your host is anything but proficient in the ways of hospitality.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Enough... The time for internal strife, now is not. Still on the offense, the mad king is and must be stopped by the Chrysos Heirs...
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: I have not forgotten about what needs to be done. Stand down. I'm more than capable of taking care of what's ahead by myself.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: As for you... {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} is in the Marmoreal Palace. Aglaea told me to stay out of it. So, go ahead... "Deliverer."
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: I don't need you to tell me that.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: What do you mean?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You, what's your name?
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Isn't that name... also strange?
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: What is it, outsider? Do you fear the {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Lance of Fury{RUBY_E#}'s raging flames? Or perhaps you'd care to spar with me?
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: No, thank you...
I'm interested.
Shatter them with the aftershocks!
Avoid getting too serious with Mydei, because he means every word he says.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: That is true. Of this, you can be assured.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: I'm sorry, we were not quick enough.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It's not too late. Leave it to us. Go, Phainon.
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: Thankfully, no one was hurt. I hope that Mydei doesn't act on his words. After all, he's an exemplary fighter, if he's dead set on doing things his way... I fear not a soul could prevent it, not even myself.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Is he your companion? You two don't seem to be on friendly terms.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Well, that's the Chrysos Heirs. Revered as heroes by the masses, but still imperfect mortals at their core.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...What a mess.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I don't see any more residents. Have they been evacuated?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Yes. Tribbie acted with haste.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: This is Marmoreal Market, the most important residential and living area in the holy city. Pushing through by force would undoubtedly result in needless casualties...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...But now our backup is here.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Lord Phainon. And... the two guests.
Welcome to Okhema.
These enemies... aren't moving?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: When I heard your footsteps, I thought Death was already writing my final chapter before my heroic journey had even begun...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Miss Castorice.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: An abrupt ending to an epic that has barely begun might also amaze the people.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: But today, Lord Phainon... Okhema needs you.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Well, if the "mortician" of the holy city says I'm needed, then it sounds like I'm gonna live through this mess.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Well... that isn't for me to decide. All I can do is clear the obstacles and guide you to the place of {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}'s descent.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Dear guests, if you would, I'd like you to please follow me...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: And kindly keep five paces distance.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Their hostility has ceased?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: In the face of death, Strife will also cause hesitation to arise. I... am the shadow of death.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Hmm... There are also some enemies who are difficult to subdue by presence alone.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The scent of blood... Are you an attendant of the {RUBY_B#Death Titan}Hand of Shadow{RUBY_E#}?
rows.speaker: Soldier of Nikador

rows.text: ...No, I'm nobody's attendant.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: You can try to avoid and hide it, but you obviously came from the world of the dead.
rows.speaker: Soldier of Nikador

rows.text: Okhema, Chrysos Heirs — what cowards. We live by loyalty and glory, while you live by weakness and deceit.
rows.speaker: Soldier of Nikador

rows.text: I'm so glad that you're not my history teacher. How much can we trust the words of someone who has sunk so deep into madness?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: However, if you're standing here out of loyalty and glory, then I shall draw my blade and grant you a warrior's end.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Come, to arms!
rows.speaker: Soldier of Nikador

rows.text: As you wish.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Lady Aglaea once said that your time is extremely valuable and shouldn't be wasted on unnecessary conflict.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I have the power to lay them to rest.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I was about to say the same. It's pointless to waste your strength on these pawns.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Let's go. It's time to face Strife.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Once there...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...You must turn into birds and fly toward the final battlefield.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Miss Castorice, why aren't you joining us?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I must stay here and ensure that these soldiers do not destroy the city.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Although faith is more important to the vast majority, there are still quite a number of citizens who care more about their worldly possessions.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I understand, but...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: There is no need for worry. The citizens have already been evacuated and the only living things in the vicinity... are the three of you.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: As Lady Aglaea instructed, no civilians will be affected by this.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...Do excuse my impropriety.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Well then, I'll see you later, Miss Castorice.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Then...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Could you all quietly leave?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Marmoreal Palace, the Lance of Fury, {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}... They're all there, in the distance.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: What a horrifying battle cry. Is that a Titan?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That battle cry once crushed all in its path. It knocked down foes and allies alike, leaving people as fragile as reeds in a gale.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: My limbs trembled uncontrollably as my weapon clattered to the ground. I could hear nothing but the frenzied and shameful beating of my own heart...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Some time later...
Fear, this is why the Strife Titan is revered. If a warrior can face this terror and still step forward, no trial thereafter can shake the weapon in their hand.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You two, if you wish to retreat, this is your final chance to do so.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Looks like the both of you have indeed braved many dangers.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We have no interest in the Titan rites. As Trailblazers, lending a helping hand to unfamiliar worlds is simply our duty.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Trailblazing... What an interesting concept. Surely, on your worlds, there must also be a Titan which is revered by the masses?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: There's no need to further confirm your resolve. We shall soon cross swords with the embodiment of Strife. And yet, faced against this menacing threat, your resolve only gleams more intensely.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Let's get going. In the era when {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#} had not yet fallen silent, none could stand as their equal. Today, we inherit the duty of the gods, safeguarding the inhabitants of Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Stand with me and become heroes!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It's deathly silent...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Deathly silence is the proud resonance of {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}'s war drums. Behind this watery veil... awaits the arena of conflict.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Who's wailing? My head feels as though it's being ripped apart...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Stay strong! Recall your convictions and everything you hold dear... If you can't do that, then think of death, for doing so might actually keep you alive!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: New allies of Okhema, welcome to Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: While this welcome banquet is far from elegant, it has helped to remove any misgivings that we had. From this moment forth, you shall be treated as distinguished guests of the holy city and of the Chrysos Heirs.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Lady Aglaea, your eyes...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Is somewhat unfocused. Could it be that...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Curious about my eyesight? Well, I'm not blind. On the contrary, I can see much more than the typical person.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Those with golden blood always have something extraordinary about them. For me, it's perception. I don't need light to measure the world — the wind carries messages along golden threads, delivering countless sensations to my fingertips.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Just like how at this present moment, the virtues possessed by the both of you have turned into a warm current that pleases my skin.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Indeed, her manner of speaking is comparable to Sunday's.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: She was just speaking metaphorically...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A manifestation of {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Could it be that my trial has not arrived yet?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: By following the threads of fate, you have begun to write the opening chapter of your story. How do you feel?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Truth be told, I don't feel any different. I anticipated a greater challenge.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: When Trianne followed those escaped soldiers, was that part of the plan too?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Naturally. We have long foreseen this attack and didn't intend to waste such a golden opportunity.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: After {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} succumbed to madness, their fortress disappeared into the fog, with no one being able to ascertain its location anymore. However, now that they have acted out of character and attacked Okhema of their own accord...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Then, the holy city shall also uncover their hiding place and sound the horn of retaliation.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: What an intricate plan indeed.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I gave my word that after the situation stabilized, I would reveal all about Amphoreus to our allies.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: However, given that Okhema has just barely survived a calamity, and there are still many shaken citizens who need comfort... Aglaea, would you mind taking care of this in my stead?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Distinguished guests, since you have spared no effort in aiding the holy city, I will naturally take care of you as well.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I've woven many unforeseen events into the tapestry of fate, this is but one instance.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: You two can find me at Marmoreal Market after you've grown tired of listening to her tales. In any case, I owe you my hospitality.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Now then, where should we begin?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Lady Aglaea, could you give us some time?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We'd like to get back to our mission now that the situation has calmed down. We want to lay down a beacon of the Trailblaze here.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I can assure you that this will not bring any repercussions to Okhema. Think of it as a ceremony when traveling to someplace new.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Beacon... of the Trailblaze...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Can I have a taste?
No problem, go ahead.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...Her serious tone immediately quashes your wild idea.
You gently pick up a piece of red clay from the container, while the dromas watches your every move intently... Don't mess it up.
With this Space Anchor on Amphoreus, we've taken yet another giant step on the Path of Trailblaze.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...I'm going to assume you meant Akivili.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What an interesting way to mark the start of your journey. I grow more and more curious about your cause.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: But, please, let me first properly extend my hospitality to you... The conversation we must have will likely be quite lengthy, so why don't we go somewhere more suitable for that?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: We're here at Marmoreal Palace, Okhema's public baths. Normally, this place would be much livelier.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: This is a good place for our chat.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Both of you are new here, so it's only natural to be confused about the prophecy, Titans, and Chrysos Heirs that have been mentioned in passing. But I'd like you to learn about Amphoreus' history before I tell you more.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: The bath sprites are excited to begin. This bath contains spirit water that has been blessed by the Ocean Titan. It can guide you back into the distant past. Go ahead, step in and listen to what the comforting ripples have to say.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: If it'll make you feel better... I can avert my gaze.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Have you seen Damionis?
She's not that gentle.

Quiet your thoughts... Feelings are far more honest than words and can better satisfy your curiosity. Close your eyes and feel the warm ripples of water embrace you. Feel the delivery of this account from the seas.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Have you seen Damionis?
The spirit water shall show you Amphoreus' distant and recent past.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: "Okie doke, make yourself comfortable~ Time for a history class on Amphoreus!"
rows.speaker: Bath Sprite

rows.text: "Amphoreus started off as a ball of chaos!"
rows.speaker: Bath Sprite

rows.text: "The three Fate Titans wrote laws to govern the world, another three Foundation Titans created the earth, ocean, and skies, and a different three Creation Titans designed and gave life to human beings — like you and me."
rows.speaker: Bath Sprite

rows.text: "But three baddie Titans soon snuck in, bringing a terrible horrible disaster with them!"
rows.speaker: Bath Sprite

rows.text: With snacks, plushies, and cute clothes.
Have you seen Damionis?
"So, the Titans got angry, and no one was willing to give in. Their followers then decided to do the same, fighting and killing each other."
rows.speaker: Bath Sprite

rows.text: "Everyone fought for a really, really long time, disturbing and hurting all people living in the world. Until one day — something big happened!"
rows.speaker: Bath Sprite

rows.text: Have you seen Damionis?
"It's not your turn! No interrupting me in class!"
rows.speaker: Bath Sprite

rows.text: "A prophecy appeared on Amphoreus! Something no one saw coming!"
rows.speaker: Bath Sprite

rows.text: "The tripartite prophecy says there is only one way to stop this war."
rows.speaker: Bath Sprite

rows.text: "Assemble a band of heroes powerful enough to take on the twelve Titans and reignite their Coreflames. Only then will their divine wrath abate, and peace return to the world."
rows.speaker: Bath Sprite

rows.text: "We know this band of heroes by a certain name~ Any guesses? That's right! The Chrysos Heirs!"
rows.speaker: Bath Sprite

rows.text: "So, here's the takeaway: Eat well and train well, so you can grow up into a powerful hero and do your part for Amphoreus!"
rows.speaker: Bath Sprite

rows.text: Hmm? Is... something else wrong?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Is that so... Looks like you're a bit hard to please. Trusting and perceptive at the same time.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Rough patch... That's a mild way to put it.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I suppose the things that are common knowledge to us are just a garbled mess to you. If we want to straighten out the threads of this world, perhaps I should explain things to you myself.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I seem to hear a note of pity in that question. Perhaps you find us to be weak and defenseless.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: We can move on to the problem at hand, now that both of you have some understanding of Amphoreus' history. Come with me.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Please give me a moment.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: The way up from here leads to a bath that the Council granted exclusively to the Chrysos Heirs. The bath is strictly off limits to anyone other than the Heirs.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I'm willing to make an exception, considering you're guests from beyond the sky. But if I were to bring both of you in at once... I'd be blatantly disrespecting our traditions.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: It's probably more of a "hero's privilege."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Seems like prophesied heroes and civilians aren't treated equally in Okhema.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Why don't you go up with her, [Trailblazer]? I don't mind waiting for you here.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You have a very considerate partner. Follow me, then.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Take a seat, [Trailblazer]. Make yourself comfortable, then close your eyes.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I won't force you, but... people hope to regard one another with bare honesty when they enter a bath. Are you willing to trust me?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...Thank you. You can also move a little to your left. The water is warmer there.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I'll get it (25,000 credits).
No, thanks.
Deal! Now, this {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} Battles the Rosy Celestial Maiden is yours!
rows.speaker: Art Merchant

rows.text: However, since you like this so much, would you like to take a look at another piece that I have? It's titled Phainon and Pie-non.
rows.speaker: Art Merchant

rows.text: No, thank you. Let's go.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Alright, feel free to look for me at anytime if you change your mind.
rows.speaker: Art Merchant

rows.text: ...You don't trust me?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Purchase the fan work (25,000 credits).
No, thanks.
Deal! Now, this {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} Battles the Rosy Celestial Maiden is yours!
rows.speaker: Art Merchant

rows.text: However, since you like this so much, would you like to take a look at another piece that I have? It's titled Phainon and Pie-non.
rows.speaker: Art Merchant

rows.text: No, thank you. Let's go.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Alright, feel free to look for me at anytime if you change your mind.
rows.speaker: Art Merchant

rows.text: Now place your left hand onto the bench. Lift your arm up with your palm facing forward, and part your fingers slightly...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...I understand now. You do not really distrust me, you just wish to show your rebellious side.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Yes, you're doing great. Alright, it's about time I formally introduce myself: I am Aglaea the Goldweaver, dressmaster of Okhema and one of the Chrysos Heirs of Amphoreus. The trust placed in me is how I came to lead the Chrysos Heirs in our mission today.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: My duty may be to weave lavish robes, but I most enjoy coming to these baths in my personal time. Garments are shields after all, hiding both our bodies and what we truly think...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: This place though, is where we can drop our cloaks of pretense, for the waters shall bring us closer together.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: What kind of decoration is this? A mask?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A Hexanexus.
A Dream Ticker.
Wow, a new toy!
It feels like this ram mask is hiding something... Let's try touching it.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The lounge chair in the room looks so comfy and enticing. You're worried that you'll completely lose the motivation to Trailblaze if you lie on it.
Think about it. All the twists and turns and hardships you've been through... are they worth it? Lying here and welcoming an eternal, comfy slumber... Maybe that's where you belong...
You can open your eyes now, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Look, we are joined together now.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: You're not wrong to think of it that way.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Trap? Hardly. Think of it as a ritual that allows us to communicate.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: The golden threads of {RUBY_B#Romance Titan}Mnestia{RUBY_E#} entwine us, capable of sensing even the slightest quiver. We are bound to speak the truth to each other this way.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Dan Heng dips two fingers into the bath to check the water temperature.
You will learn the truth about this world from me, and in return, I ask for you to promise me something.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: "Great," you think silently in your mind, trying hard not to let him see your schadenfreude.

You lean against the stone railing of the balcony, gazing into the distance. The mist-shrouded mountains of Amphoreus appear as vague outlines, like stone giants slowly shifting between crouching and standing.
From somewhere, a bard's song drifts through the air. Though the words are unclear, the melody still conveys a tinge of nostalgia and longing for the past.
Fulfill this pact between us, and you can expect your journey on Amphoreus to be free of troubles.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: You agree with Dan Heng, very much so.
Did you feel that? The golden threads are rippling. They reveal the distrust you still have for Okhema, and I take it upon myself to dispel these concerns.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: The dromas lets out a slow but joyful sound, clearly anticipating your performance as its new caretaker.
Should it get what it wants so easily, or...?
Offer the redsoil feed to the dromas.
You learned the legends of Amphoreus from those bath sprites a while ago, but that was a sanitized version that spared you from the harsh and bitter realities of our history.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: The pantheon of Titans that once ruled our world has become the very affliction that eats away at Amphoreus. An unfathomable power changed something within most of these Titans, inducing their rage and madness.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Amphoreus has since fallen into eternal night, the black tide engulfing our world. Okhema is now the only city to still receive light, and we owe it to {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#}'s protection.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: The murals record in simple and delicate carvings the stories of {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#} creating life and building Okhema.

In the murals, {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#} bears the enormous Dawn Device on their back. Golden divine blood courses across their body, flowing to the ground from the left-hand side of their chest and spreading in all directions.
At their feet, the humans bathed in the golden blood work together to create a great city. This city is Okhema, the origin of Amphoreus civilization.
The Chrysos Heirs gathered here are Amphoreus' only hope. People hail us as heroes, as protectors, and as deliverers...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...They are counting on us to vanquish the Titans, reclaim their Coreflames, topple them from their thrones, and take their authority for ourselves.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: It is only upon reclaiming all Coreflames that the miracle of genesis can reveal itself, granting a new lease on life to this broken world.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: This is Amphoreus' Flame-Chase Journey — "a band of heroes dedicated to slaying the gods and reclaiming the twelve Coreflames for the world to start over anew."
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: With the end times before us, we are expected to lead all of our people toward the summit. Okhema needs as many allies as possible, to aid us in the upcoming battles.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: The two of you may be just the "reinforcements" that the Chrysos Heirs have been waiting for.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: If I'm putting my hopes in the wrong place, so be it. But for Amphoreus, I am willing to take the chance.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: You must have been blessed by many miracles to say that with such unwavering confidence.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I may be getting ahead of myself, but for Amphoreus, I am willing to take a chance on you.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I have laid my heart bare, and in return, I just want you to make a single promise.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Come on... Put in more strength!
rows.speaker: Okhema Resident 1

rows.text: Why did it have to fall right in front of our home...
rows.speaker: Okhema Resident 2

rows.text: Maybe someone should go fetch a priest?
rows.speaker: Okhema Resident 3

rows.text: A miracle... A miracle fresh from the oven!
rows.speaker: Okhema Resident 1

rows.text: Go, bring word to the bard.
rows.speaker: Okhema Resident 1

rows.text: Frontier heroes grace Okhema, feats abound right here...
rows.speaker: Okhema Resident 1

rows.text: Who is shouting?
A world beyond the sky? Can you even speak of that?
Celestial maiden! Celestial maiden!
rows.speaker: Child 4

rows.text: Promise me to never tell the people of Okhema about the worlds beyond the sky, no matter what may happen.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I'm Damionis! And I will prove it to everyone!
rows.speaker: Damionis

rows.text: I'm glad to hear that. Please understand, Okhema is approaching its end, and I do not wish to give my people false hope... Not when we've been badly scarred by it before.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Okhema is approaching its end. I do not wish to give my people false hope... Not when we've been badly scarred by it before.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Can you promise me that?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Thank you, [Trailblazer]. The agreement between us is now complete.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I apologize if this ritual upset you, but I hope you understand... I had no other choice.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: As much as I am interested to hear your story, I'm afraid I've already taken up too much of your time... Mr. Dan Heng's worrying has created ripples in the water.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Why don't the both of you tour our "holy city"? See how our people make ends meet in this difficult time. I will have your welcome gifts ready later today.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: You're finally back. What did she say to you?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Promise not to tell her people about our interstellar voyages... I didn't expect that to be her only concern. Though this is consistent with how Phainon was acting when we were at the Abyss.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Something is definitely off about this world. Even on a planet as isolated as Jarilo-VI, the people still had an understanding of space, and even Paths and Aeons.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The sky above Amphoreus, though, is more like... a prison. They clearly have advanced technology, so who could imagine that even discussing what's beyond the sky would be taboo?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Do you remember the mass of chaotic matter concealing Amphoreus from the rest of the universe? I can't help thinking that someone is intentionally keeping Amphoreus hidden. Their Titans could also be related to some Aeon.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Rosy Celestial Maiden, Okhema's light...
My radiant maiden, how I wish to witness your beauty...
The maiden talk is just a lie!
I'd say it's Aquila's daughter.
Rosy Celestial Maiden? Is she famous?
Rosy Celestial Maiden and Lady Aglaea, who is more beautiful?
Unfortunately, it didn't make it into the Forum.
Which city is Rosy Celestial Maiden from?
Rosy Celestial Maiden merch! Come get them right here!
rows.speaker: Art Merchant

rows.text: Phainon promised to fix it. We can ask him about it when we see him.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Let's explore the city like Aglaea suggested. We helped defend the place, after all. This is a good chance to fish around for information while they still have a good impression of us.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What's all this fuss...
rows.speaker: Merchant 1

rows.text: Can't a guy run his business in peace?
rows.speaker: Merchant 1

rows.text: That guy...
rows.speaker: Citizen 2

rows.text: Barged into the Chrysos Heirs' baths?
rows.speaker: Citizen 2

rows.text: He was just shouting about... the Rosy Celestial Maiden?
rows.speaker: Citizen 3

rows.text: Maybe we should go home to stay safe...
rows.speaker: Citizen 3

rows.text: I want to become a celestial maiden one day!
rows.speaker: Child 4

rows.text: Stop that nonsense!
rows.speaker: Parent 5

rows.text: Be realistic!
rows.speaker: Parent 5

rows.text: We can also take some photos for our records.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That's fast. The citizens are already back in the city.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Why are they gathered there?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Excuse me... Do you need help?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You are...? What strange clothing and accent you have...
rows.speaker: Disturbed Resident

rows.text: Oh! Are you the warriors that followed Lord Phainon back from the frontier?
rows.speaker: Disturbed Resident

rows.text: Looks like Phainon is helping Aglaea keep that secret, too. There must be some kind of understanding among the Chrysos Heirs.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Yes, there must be some kind of understanding among the Chrysos Heirs.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That's nowhere near as puzzling as how we have a common tongue.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng
