rows.text: Are we... actually forcing the Titans to do our bidding with these miracles?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We can't afford to stop and think about that right now. Let's press on.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...It won't open?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Perhaps... this gate only opens in the right time dimension?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: There! Those Miracle Orbs are instruments often used by Time Priests. They could prove handy.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Look, an inverse time dimension is reflected by those orbs.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Let's summon another miracle. Perhaps this time we'll make it through.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Great. Should be smooth sailing from here.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: At last, we're out... That place was in total disarray.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The distorted time and space... is likely a reflection of {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}'s own twisted struggles.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: This gate looks just as magnificent up close.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Gate of Infinity. It represents the divine power of {RUBY_B#Passage Titan}Janus{RUBY_E#}. According to legend, {RUBY_B#Passage Titan}Janus{RUBY_E#} is the eldest of the Three Titans of Fate. They created the "space" of Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: But the {RUBY_B#Passage Titan, Janus}Titan{RUBY_E#} has long fallen and surrendered their Coreflame. Tribbie is the demigod that inherited their divinity.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: But that doesn't mean Tribbie isn't powerful enough... She's one of Amphoreus' most revered heroes.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: But you're not wrong, strength is no measure for how powerful Tribbie is. She's one of Amphoreus' most revered heroes.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Let's go. With Tribbie's token, we should be able to go straight into the Temple of the Three Fates.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Please pardon me. Words this vile should not be relayed.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: It's not going to be easy getting {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}'s help.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: This temple has been forsaken for so long that we have no way of telling what dangers await us behind this gate. From the way Oronyx spoke to us in the ruins, I won't count on them being cordial toward us.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: "Venture no closer... Keep out."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "You won't find anything you desire here... Save for despair and demise."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Is that you, {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Forgive me, but if you refuse to help us, then despair and demise will be all that's left on this world!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: "You are not welcome here... You have no right."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "You'll never pass my challenge."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: A challenge? Great, at least they're willing to speak to us now. Even if they are only making things difficult for us.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Push onward, my friends. But watch your step.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The silence is deafening.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This place... isn't as I knew it.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The Scales of Justice. It's my first time seeing it in its full glory.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Is this also a symbol of a Titan?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Law Titan}Talanton{RUBY_E#}, the second of the Three Titans of Fate. They were said to have created the laws that govern our world.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Talanton surrendered their Coreflame, though the Chrysos Heir taking over their legacy is... nowhere to be found today.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: At least the laws that govern our world are still in place. So that demigod must be performing their duty still, no matter where they are.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Neither of these are paths we can take, and the exit has been concealed from us. Looks like {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#} is bent on keeping us out.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The Tome of Miracles... We'll just have to try our luck with this, then.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: "Hurts... it hurts... so much."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Does performing a miracle really... subject them to that much pain?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Look, the broken scales have been restored to their full form.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Memories, remain... Always.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Memories, remain... Always.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: "No... You cannot... You must not come any closer."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "The scales are as much an entrance... as they are a challenge."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The scales...? Are they expecting us to balance it?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I believe so...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...Are you alright, Miss Castorice?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I—I'm fine. It's just... I can feel {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}'s misery.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Being able to understand the Titans' words is as much an affliction as it is a gift. Let's get this over and done with.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: There's an abandoned Hand of Zagreus here. Let's use it.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Does that Titan really intend to deter us with a challenge like this?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What do you mean, Mr. Dan Heng?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: This doesn't make sense to me. Oronyx thinks of us as intruders, so isn't it far easier for them to forcefully stop us with their divine powers?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}... based on my understanding, isn't the kind that resorts to brutality.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Does this mean we've passed the challenge?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}! We completed your challenge. Can you let us pass now?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: "No... Unsatisfactory... You cannot pass."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Looks like this Titan doesn't like to keep their promises.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Another... challenge. Must deter... the mortals."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Are they just stalling for time? We don't have the time for games...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: They seem somewhat fickle, much like... a child.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Something that has more weight than the fate of the world? That's a baffling riddle.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: No movement at all... Not the right item.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Obtuse... blind fools..."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...They really know how to get under someone's skin.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Look, behind that gate. Isn't that the exact same type of weight?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: If we can use it to balance the scales and add more weight to the pan, we might be able to solve {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}'s riddle.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: My intuition says this won't be that easy... But I suppose we don't have any better solutions at the moment.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If that Titan is truly so childlike, maybe they're just playing with us. In that case, let's play along until they're satisfied.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This won't do... We're just wasting our time.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I don't think there's a need for me to convey any words that'll only irritate you further.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: There's an obstacle ahead.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Perhaps the Miracle Orbs can illuminate the way forward.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Accompany {M#him,}{F#her,} Mem...
rows.speaker: Oronyx

rows.text: {M#He}{F#She} will make the memories of this world complete once again... {M#He}{F#She} will find... Mother...
rows.speaker: Oronyx

rows.text: There, a Prophecy Tablet. It could be the key to unlocking the way.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Everything's going well... so far.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: There are also stone platforms for the Hand of Zagreus all around. This will save us the trouble of doubling back.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It worked! Now, the scales have once again been balanced.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: "You think that you've won? Arrogant... Foolish..."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Titan, are you still trying to hold out?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: We just have to make the weighing pan on this side drop, right?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Let's think about it... It shouldn't be that difficult.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It didn't even move an inch...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I've held [Trailblazer]'s flaming lance before and it's quite heavy. Seems like this isn't going to work.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}... is mocking us.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: ...Have you thought of gaining some weight?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Come down, [Trailblazer]... Seems like this isn't going to work.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]? Are you feeling alright?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: It seems like we can't rely on brute force to clear this challenge.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: [Trailblazer], hand me March's camera.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Indeed, for the people of Amphoreus, the fate of the world is a weight that is far too heavy.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: But perhaps even the Titan did not expect that... For outsiders like [Trailblazer] and I, we still have not yet become fully involved with the fate of this world.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: From our perspective, there is something even more important than this world, or perhaps even the entire cosmos.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: And that's the companions that we have traveled with.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If this is indeed the case, we will have passed the Titan's challenge.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: That was an unexpected solution... Thankfully, we had Dan Heng and [Trailblazer] here with us.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I think that even {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#} themself is surprised that we managed to clear the challenge.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: At least they kept their promise and opened the path for an audience.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: This...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It feels like a cold wave is seeping into the mind, and a hand with countless fingers is churning through my memories.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Maybe people who have led wonderful lives would enjoy such an intrusion...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: "Refuse... refuse."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I understand. Such a spectacle is rare to witness.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Titans all have vastly different physical forms, with some of them even abandoning their physical shell.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Not every Titan is as violent as {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}... They weren't always like that either.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: "Futile attempts... Give up... give up."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: We've played along with you for long enough. It's time you admitted defeat, {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Let's go and complete their challenge.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: Accept Oronyx's invitation.
Please give me a moment...
*Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: "Come with me... Follow me and join me... as we look far into your past..."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: "Waiting... Hate waiting..."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: [Trailblazer], if you do plan to accept their invitation... it's best that you don't let them wait for too long.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's you again...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Where do you want to take me?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: It's you. It's me. Where? With you.
You want to look into... my memories?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: Memories. Yours. Look into? Curious.
Future? Past. Observe. Secrets...
This is... the Express?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Is this... a memory?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Where? Here.
*Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: It's that voice again... Let's follow it.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Is that... me?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: There's also Himeko and Dan Heng... What memory is this?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: "Leave... leave."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Help us, Titan! Help us prevent this world from being ruined by madness!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: ...We've got a decent harvest this time. Although we deviated slightly from the "script," it's not a big deal.
rows.speaker: Himeko?

rows.text: Thanks for your hard work, [Trailblazer]. I'm very glad that you're not hurt.
rows.speaker: Himeko?

rows.text: Heh... Not going to share what's on your mind? Traveling with two quiet people really makes the trip feel a little lonely.
rows.speaker: Himeko?

rows.text: ...I'm hungry.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]?

rows.text: Is this really the only time you'll say something? Come on, dinner is ready.
rows.speaker: Himeko?

rows.text: ...If possible, can we not have Beef Offal Stew for once?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng?

rows.text: Why? You don't like the taste of home?
rows.speaker: Himeko?

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: I dislike the gamey taste of offal.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng?

rows.text: What's going on...? Are these really my memories?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: I have no recollection of this conversation at all... Himeko and Dan Heng's tone also seem different. What exactly is going on...?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Memory. Forgotten, chaotic.
We. Confusion, uncover.
Something Mydei was born with. A blessing and a curse — the true mark of a Chrysos Heir.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Kafka... Blade!?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: No, these aren't my memories... There must have been some mistake.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Something Mydei was born with. A blessing and a curse — the true mark of a Chrysos Heir.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Memories, discrepancies? Correct. Truth.
Depths, hidden. Forgotten. Forgotten...
Do you have any dietary restrictions, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: I'll eat anything.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]?

rows.text: Brute force isn't the only option. Some Titans can also be vanquished... in other ways.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Brute force isn't the only option. Some Titans can also be vanquished... in other ways.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You really aren't picky about food.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Another set of nonexistent memories... This time, Sam's also here.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Getting to know myself from a different perspective... feels a little strange.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: You place the flaming lance and the bat on the scale's tray...
You dexterously leap onto the scale's tray...
You swing the baseball bat hard at the scale's tray...
The "script" turned out to be extremely dangerous. It's only because of [Trailblazer]'s quick thinking that we managed to escape.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: Dancing on the razor's edge all the time, it's only a matter of time before disaster catches up with us... Kafka.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: I accept your criticism, Sam. Indeed... Because of the "script," I failed to consider the possibility of failure.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: "I have crossed the myriad passages and been judged by the scales."
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: I suppose even Stellaron Hunters could use a retreat signal to respond to dire circumstances.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: There's no time like the present. Why don't we come up with one right now?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: I'll leave it to you.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: Bladie?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: "Three of a kind..."
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: "Two pair..."
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: "Ace."
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: You and Phainon retreat using the opportunity and return to Okhema...
Ah... It reeks of Xianzhou. Aren't you afraid you'll be bound by your past?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: It's just a passphrase from the past... No matter. There won't be a need for us to use it.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Three of a kind, two pair, ace...
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: What a catchy yet refined catchphrase.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Remember to recite this a few more times in your mind the next time you're toying with your prey.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: When did you become so ruthless?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: (It's the first time that the Express has felt so unfamiliar...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (I want to take a look in the Parlor Car...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Just what is going on...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: These memories obviously don't exist in my mind... But they feel so real that I cannot dispute them.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: [Trailblazer]... Can I help you?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Why are you here...
Why am I here?
What's wrong? You seem... very nervous.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Don't worry, the dust will eventually settle. Let's go through the "script" one more time...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Firefly?
What "script"...
...What's up? I'm in a raid and don't have time for small talk.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: How did I join you guys?
Stop playing and tell me the truth!
Oh... I've only just joined recently. If you have questions, can't you just ask Kafka?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Anyway, online games cannot be paused. So, if you don't mind.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Silver Wolf?
I'm just worried you'll become addicted.
What's the matter, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: ...Explanation?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: ...Forget?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: [Trailblazer], did I do something that made you unhappy?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: We're partners, and I don't want anything to come between us, not even doubt.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: I think...
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: What's wrong?
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Guided by the "script," we've assembled here to temporarily accomplish a common goal... That's all.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: I don't care about anything else.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: I'll give you one piece of advice — don't let Kafka down. She sacrificed a lot to keep you here... furthermore...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Blade?
Don't leave me hanging...
I don't understand... What's the point of all of this?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Happiness... sealed away...
Mother... Are you still there?
Are you watching?
Memories flowing in reverse... Pounding.
rows.speaker: Oronyx

rows.text: Outside the window... Remember. Look outside the window.
rows.speaker: Oronyx

rows.text: You are? I am... Who?
Gaze, watching. Outside, cold.
You... warm. Me like, warmth.
Confusion... Same. Answer, unknown.
I've finally found it... Precious memory. At long last... I've caught THEIR gaze.
rows.speaker: Oronyx

rows.text: Mem... Address. Temporarily.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Mother? Who? Don't remember.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Mem... Address. For now.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: Travel, like. With you, together?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: Memory... collected. Piece together, complete.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Ador... Nik? Titan?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Need, memories. Help... I can.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Shadow in the memory...
rows.speaker: Oronyx

rows.text: They... are your companions?
rows.speaker: Oronyx

rows.text: Bad people. Troublesome. Help, needed.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Together... Friend?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Victory, victory!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Mighty, companions!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Disappear, temporarily.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Leave... It's, time.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: Farewell. Time, there is.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Companions, regrets... Don't leave.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Kafka... and Firefly.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Phainon raises the stone talisman of {RUBY_B#Passage Titan}Janus{RUBY_E#}...
...The sound of heavy mechanisms comes from the Temple of the Three Fates.
*Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: Who should I bid farewell to...?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: [Trailblazer]... You're here.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Once again, we've completed the "script" without a hitch.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Has something happened? You look... vulnerable.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: You know I'd never ever do that, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Tell me what's on your mind. You're used to confiding in me by now, aren't you?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: I see... You have lost your "past" and are feeling very helpless.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Unfortunately, I'm not Destiny's Slave. I can't peer into the future. I can neither fill the gaps in your memory nor tell you what we later experienced together.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Such cruel words... You must have gone through a lot afterward.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: But in the end, we will meet again, which also means... I'll always get you back.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: [Trailblazer], listen...
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: I suppose, in that script I haven't yet read, you'll face plenty of danger and end up in dreadful predicaments.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: You'll probably also experience many wonderful things and find companions who feel like family, even if it's no longer with us, the Stellaron Hunters.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: You'll also embark on adventures beyond your wildest imagination. After all, you were born for adventure.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: There's only one thing that I want you to always remember: No matter where you go or which corner of the cosmos you may be in, you will always be able to find a safe haven by my side.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Patience may not be my virtue... But toward you, it is something that I will never lack.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Goodbye, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: When fate places you at a crossroads... make your choice boldly, and don't fear regret.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Oh, [Trailblazer], it's you.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: We've successfully completed the "script" once again, right? It's always reassuring to have you by our side.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Is something the matter? I've never seen you look like this before.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: What... does that mean?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: What happened? I... I don't actually know whether I should ask you this question. But... I just wanted to express my concern, for my companion.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Is that so... Will this journey also be cut short suddenly?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: But... it's okay. You being here means our paths are bound to cross again. You're alive, and I will continue living. The parting that has yet to happen will not be an eternal one.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Hmm... There's no need to say anything. Your eyes have already given me an answer.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: "Weights in the left weighing pan... represent the fate of Amphoreus."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "Find... something that weighs more... and place it in the right pan..."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: "Find something that has more weight... than the fate of the world."
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I'll try to forget this and lock it away in the depths of my memory... When the day of our parting comes, I'll treat your words as a promise for our reunion.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: When the day we cross paths again arrives, I think... I'll pretend we've never met, and get to know you anew, as if starting all over.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I will also try my best to express my thoughts openly to you... Because right now, I'm still unable to do it.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: A day worth waiting for. Two people — no longer accomplices, just two drifting souls in the cosmos — meeting and getting to know each other in the most ordinary way...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...That is the greatest luxury that I can ever imagine.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: That's it, that look on your face is the [Trailblazer] that I know.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: You're leaving, right? Because there's something important that you have to do... You always understand what's the most important.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Go, [Trailblazer]. It doesn't matter if you forget everything... I shall engrave the promise of our second reunion in my heart on your behalf.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...But it doesn't budge. And your arm feels numb from the strong recoil.
I hope that it'll be a beautiful night with shooting stars.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: [Trailblazer], what happened?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: What did they say, Castorice?

rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Something that has more weight than the fate of the world...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...No, Lord Phainon.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: [Trailblazer], I've got it.

rows.text: Pass out? What are you talking about?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Long? What are you talking about?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It hadn't even been a full minute when...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...This creature appeared.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Such a unique animal. I think it's an animal? I have never seen anything like it before.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: What a cute little creature... Is it a gift from {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Fuli? Just now?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Fuli... What's that?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Remember the Aeons that I spoke to you about on the way to Okhema? Fuli is one of them and presides over the Path of Remembrance.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Ahh... A god from the worlds beyond the sky. A miracle that is hard to see with the naked eye... Right?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: To earn the gaze of an Aeon, does that mean...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Titan, past... Foggy.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Collect. Past... Reappear.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: You can understand what they are saying?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Collect the memories and recreate the past... How can we do that? We don't have much time left.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Anxious, no need! I will. Teach you.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: If they are truly a creation of Fuli, or have some connection to that Aeon, I'm willing to believe they can wield a power greater than {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}'s Miracle.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Let's go, we need to follow them.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}... Have you fallen into a slumber?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: *Titan's murmurs*
rows.speaker: Titan's Voice

rows.text: I don't know who the "Mother" that you're referring to is, but...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Thank you for all your hard work. If Titans can dream... May your dream be a sweet one.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: As the mission has been completed, Tribbie arrives per your summons and brings you back to Okhema.
Mydei and I will be waiting for you on the battlefield.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Don't worry about me, surviving the impossible is my specialty.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Pet, not!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Mem, believe. Follow, friends!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Memories, ballads... Collect!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.speaker: Bard Lipos

rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: There, done. Memory, collected.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.speaker: Bard Lipos

rows.text: Allow me to sing it for you—
rows.speaker: Bard Lipos

rows.text: "The war of a thousand years has drawn to its close. And now the world descends into a long night of chaos. O valiant Titan, tell me, how did your golden heart shatter into a thousand fragments?"
rows.speaker: Bard Lipos

rows.text: "O god, have you grown weary of endless strife? Then how do you justify your ruthless tyranny? And how shall you cast off the darkness that so deeply shrouds your divinity?"
rows.speaker: Bard Lipos

rows.text: "O god, have you forgotten the glory of old? Then how will you defend your dignity? And where shall your faithful subjects find their home?"
rows.speaker: Bard Lipos

rows.text: Here. Here!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: "O mighty {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}, the truth is clear to us all. Your steadfast divinity is not vanquished. You are shrouded momentarily by that encroaching black tide."
rows.speaker: Bard Lipos

rows.text: "But you never faltered, nor did you flee! Your golden warrior spirit, brave and bold, will conquer the black tide, as foretold. To the throne of Kremnos, you'll return once more!"
rows.speaker: Bard Lipos

rows.text: "Our god, our king, to aid your timeless struggle, we have prepared a grand ritual—"
rows.speaker: Bard Lipos

rows.text: "Please grant us the honor to touch your soul with our humble hands, and present to you this sacred Sword Vessel... It shall consecrate your eternal life and enshrine your everlasting glory."
rows.speaker: Bard Lipos

rows.text: Thank you, esteemed bard with an enchanting voice. Your ballads will endure through the ages, serving as a bulwark for Okhema.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Memory, craftsman... Collect!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Courage, Honor, Reason, Tenacity, Sacrifice...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} did live up to these values in their prime, but now...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: If we can pose as participants, we might be able to get into the city...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: Gladiator swords, maces, and bucklers crafted by the Grand Craftsman Chartonus himself!
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: Looking to breeze through your foes at the Kremnos Festival? I've got the best weapons right here for you!
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: Oh... Castorice. Outlander, as well.
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: To Chartonus, what brings you?
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: Hmph... Those boorish warriors know nothing about quality gear!
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: I'm as honest a merchant as they come! Those boorish warriors know nothing about quality gear!
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: Ah, but you're not like them! With your air of sophistication, you must be a noble from one of the grand city-states, right? Here, let me show you what I have in stock...
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: I remember the Kremnoans commissioned you to craft a divine object before. Do you happen to recall the details?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Ah... Happened it did. Why ask, do you?
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: The craftsmanship of a weapon reveals the time period it's made... We can afford to take a quick look.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]... Much as we're in a memory of the past, impulse buying is still an undesirable behavior.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Wahaha, you're quite the high-roller! Thank you, and please come again!
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: May I take a look at that weapon, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I thought you'd be the kind to make impulsive purchases, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss.} [Trailblazer], but you've certainly proven me wrong.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Tsk. So you're just window shopping? What a waste of my time...
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: Mister, can I please have a look at the weapon you're holding on to?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Oh? A gentle lady like you taking an interest in weapons? Why, of course! Please, feel free to take a closer look!
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: Hm...
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: Thousands of marvels of weaponry, I crafted. Remember them all, impossible it is.

rows.text: In the name of the five virtues of {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}, stride through the holy city's gate and embrace your fate.
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: May your courageous souls satisfy {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} and fuel the conquests of Kremnos.
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: Is this the exit? Oh, it's locked.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Let's focus on igniting the braziers first.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Barricades... We must find a way to remove them.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...Wait.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Outlander, forgive me. Help, I cannot.
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: That makes sense. With such a long life, the Grand Craftsman can't remember every single item he's made. Is there another way?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Please keep it together, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Hush... Listen.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Heh heheh...
Looks like I've hit the jackpot this time...
I hear it now. That's...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Pretend you did not hear anything. Act oblivious.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: We'll find a way to make him come out of hiding.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: It's the same mechanism... We need to ignite the two braziers to unlock the way forward.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Let's clear this trial together, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: An exquisite stone... It's a shame it appeared somewhere it doesn't belong.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: We may be able to temporarily remove it with the orb?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Reveal yourself, O warrior spirit... I know that you have yet to rest.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I ask for you to guide us. Let us see what you once gazed upon, let us hear what your ears once heard...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Stay here, warrior... Do not leave your Goddess of Death. The enticing scent of blood here is meant for you, and only you...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Sweet... death.
rows.speaker: Furiae Praetor

rows.text: Inner... peace.
rows.speaker: Furiae Praetor

rows.text: Mem, knows!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Help, friend! Memory, retrieve!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer], are you feeling alright?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: You were in the same state as when you were with {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Break free from your shackles and return to your divine body.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Grand Craftsman, would it be possible for you to craft a Sword Vessel that can seal divinity?
rows.speaker: Kremnos High Elder

rows.text: Anything my forging hammer cannot craft, there is not.
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: The finest stones in Kremnos, give me. The golden blood of Strife Titan, find me. The Sword Vessel, I shall craft.
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: Does that mean we have a deal?
rows.speaker: Kremnos High Elder

rows.text: Break free from your shackles and return to your divine body.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: And what of your payment? For a commission of this magnitude, proper compensation must be ensured.
rows.speaker: Kremnos High Elder

rows.text: Payment... simple.
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: Peace, for my people. Mountain Dwellers, no longer servants or fighters for Kremnos. Ever.
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: ...You have my word, Grand Craftsman.
rows.speaker: Kremnos High Elder

rows.text: Break free from your shackles and return to your divine body.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer], are you feeling alright? You were—
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I saw the memory of the Grand Craftsman.
Ah, was it because of this little one? That's incredible!
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The ability to look into others' memories sounds like something that could easily be misused. Luckily, you're the one wielding it.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Break free from your shackles and return to your divine body.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: The souls of the sacrificed are still wandering this hall... I hear their endless bemoaning, their senseless deaths have left them wronged, their mournful wails echo endlessly.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Perhaps I can learn something from their cries...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Memory, observed. Happiness... take!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Memories, photos... Collect!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Here. Here!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Is that... Damionis? Did Lady Aglaea release him already?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Here. Here!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: That guy... He almost got us killed!
Has that dude never heard of copyright before?
He certainly has a bad reputation. If it weren't for him, you and Dan Heng wouldn't have been interrogated by Lady Aglaea.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I've heard some bad things about him. He may have some talent in the arts, but if it weren't for him, you and Dan Heng wouldn't have been interrogated by Lady Aglaea.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: But if Mem thinks he has some valuable memories, we'd better ask him in person.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...Hmm? Who's that? I'm busy working on a scene, please don't...
rows.speaker: Damionis

rows.text: Ah, it's the esteemed "outlander." How've you been? It hasn't been all that long since we last met...
rows.speaker: Damionis

rows.text: My apologies, that was entirely my fault. I was determined to prove that a world beyond the sky exists...
rows.speaker: Damionis

rows.text: Fortunately, Lady Aglaea is quite lenient. She let me go after I made a vow.
rows.speaker: Damionis

rows.text: Lady Aglaea is quite lenient. She let me go after I made a vow.
rows.speaker: Damionis

rows.text: Rest assured, I'm not foolish enough to make the same mistake twice. Breaking a vow with Lady Aglaea would be like... digging my own grave.
rows.speaker: Damionis

rows.text: Castrum Kremnos? For us unarmed civilians, {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}'s territory is off-limits. Even in the past...
rows.speaker: Damionis

rows.text: Oh, n–no... Wait, I just remembered! I did visit Castrum Kremnos once. Let me find it for you...
rows.speaker: Damionis

rows.text: Y–Yes, yes, this is the one! I can't believe I still have it...
rows.speaker: Damionis

rows.text: I understand how you feel, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]. But right now, we must head to another battlefield.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Exactly. We'll only be able to help them once we've seen our own mission through.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: We'll only be able to help them once we've seen our own mission through.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Here, memory, complete. Give me, fragments.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Aglaea extends her arm, signaling the girl to do the same.
...What is it?
rows.speaker: Silent Gladiator

rows.text: War has left its mark on many from this period, so please don't take it personally...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...He was killed by Lord Mydei.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: No... I don't believe that Lord Mydei left out of cowardice. It was, in fact, a courageous choice.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: They are entitled to that rage... because Lord Mydei was once the hero of Castrum Kremnos.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: With that, we should have enough to determine the time period we are currently in.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Those weapons reek of blood. He made an effort to conceal it, but traces of death aren't something you can easily erase... I shudder to even consider where he got his goods from.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The safest bet is to play by the rules. They happen to be hosting a festival in the city... We can try entering as participants?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: That's too risky of a plan. And I might even become a burden to you.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I... can't control my strength with that much precision, the risk is too great.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: This was a time when life was valued far less than bread. People hardly bat their eyelids at the savagery and death that had become commonplace.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Hm? Who are...
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: Have faith, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]... Lord Phainon and Lord Mydei are still fighting. We must match their unwavering resolve.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Castorice.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Castorice.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: It is an honor to see your true faces revealed by the radiant glow of The Blade of Fury.
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: Meaningless...
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: I've said it before: To obliterate the deeply entrenched roots of foolishness within Castrum Kremnos.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: ...That's why all of your weapons reek of blood.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I think... you're right.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Better off forgotten.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: I smell fear... You're scared?
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Out of cowardice. They are afraid of losing their faith and guidance.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: They are fighting against the unseen, they have no time for the folly of mortals.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Lord Gnaeus, you seem to know a lot about that Titan.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I... I'm fine, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]. There's no need to worry.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I knew it.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Calm yourself, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]... I believe he has no ill intent toward us.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I'm fine... {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: King Eurypon wanted to strip {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} of their divinity and seal it within an intricate vessel for all eternity.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: The answer's very simple...
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Let's see what you can do, delver of memories.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: The resonance between you and {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#} must be strong.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: History has taken a wrong turn... and must be set on the right course once more.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Much time has passed, yet the Titan's soul remains fragmented. That covetous king and his servants would have turned to dust by now... Their scheme that once unfolded here has likewise been buried with them.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: So, there are mortals who fight against fate even in this hopelessly bleak era. I am impressed.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Agreed.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Come, help me piece together Strife's divinity.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Could you tell us the story behind it?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: During the final days of the Chrysos War, the final festival took place in Castrum Kremnos. However, due to the tense situation, few outsiders were willing to compete.
rows.speaker: Damionis

rows.text: The City of Warriors, its magnificence certainly lives up to its name.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: We should first figure out which era we've traveled back to.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...We may draw suspicion this way. Castrum Kremnos is no leisure spot for tourists. We shouldn't draw unnecessary attention to ourselves.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: It's... quite intriguing, indeed. But Castrum Kremnos is no leisure spot for tourists. We shouldn't draw unnecessary attention to ourselves.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Let's start with the city's surroundings. We might be able to gather some clues by listening and observing.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: All of these... They're—
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: There is only one option.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: There is only one way to do so.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: The seal that binds their divinity is already broken. As long as we complete the soul-forging here, {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} will be whole once more.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: {F#She}{M#He} knows what it truly means to go to battle. Perhaps {F#she}{M#he} can be your inspiration.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: I gathered the courage to go there, but I found the atmosphere of the festival to be... quite strange. It felt more like the Kremnoans were preparing for a mysterious ceremony.
rows.speaker: Damionis

rows.text: Sensing something was off, I snapped a photo outside the city and then left... And what followed was something completely unexpected.
rows.speaker: Damionis

rows.text: Would you mind giving us the photo? We're... trying to piece together clues from that time.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Sure, take it! Think of it as my way of making it up to you.
rows.speaker: Damionis

rows.text: Done. Memory, collected.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Memory... collected!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Kremnos... go! Help, friend!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: What did they say, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Is everything in order? If so, we need to meet up with Lords Phainon and Mydei.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Before we leave, I'd like to check with Lady Aglaea again. Do you mind waiting for me, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Everything's set now. Let's head out, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Scared? No, I just don't want to see her disappointed.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: There, done. Memory, collected.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: I just don't want to see her disappointed.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Lady Aglaea's contributions to Okhema deserve more appreciation, but people mostly see her as distant and aloof.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: We don't have time to talk about this right now... Let's set off. Hopefully, this little one will help us recreate the memories of Castrum Kremnos.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Friend, trust! Go, Kremnos!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Remember, Aglaea, whether it be the Chrysos Heirs or the Council, our positions are entrusted to us by the people of Okhema.
rows.speaker: Elder Caenis

rows.text: Before you attempt to overreach and make decisions beyond your place, take a moment to recall the Chrysos War and what became of those "heroes."
rows.speaker: Elder Caenis

rows.text: If you're not well-versed in that history, have her refresh your memory.
rows.speaker: Elder Caenis

rows.text: Do not be concerned, Elder Caenis. Following the prophecy's guidance, we shall cast down the gods — in the new world, no god will stand above humankind.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Heh... I'll hold you to that promise for now.
rows.speaker: Elder Caenis

rows.text: The pampered little girl has grown up to be a shrewd politician. Should I be pleased or concerned?
rows.speaker: Elder Caenis

rows.text: Times are changing drastically, and people must adapt. I'm not the only one committed to making a difference, Elder Caenis.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: My teacher and I have other pressing matters to attend to. Please see yourself out.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Heh... I genuinely hope that at the next Council meeting, you won't be the one standing in the middle, facing the judgment.
rows.speaker: Elder Caenis

rows.text: Agy... Are you alright?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: It's nothing more than an empty threat, much like before — a reflection of their inner fears.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: So sorry, Agy... If we were more mature, you wouldn't have to face all this alone.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Why apologize? We each have our own responsibilities.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: But seeing how they give you a hard time... makes us sad, and angry...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Would you like me to slice their throats with golden threads? It would be done in a flash. All I need is your blessing, and the Council will be no more.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Wh—What are you talking about!? D—Don't scare us like that, Agy!
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Haha, I'm just teasing you.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I knew you were joking... You certainly have an unorthodox way of cheering people up!
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: However, after you said that, we somehow feel a bit better. Thank you, Agy.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: We find humor in hardship because our humanity still endures.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: So, about the "infiltration" Snowy mentioned earlier, did you find anything?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Don't worry. Even without their intel, I've already detected hidden currents within the city. A trivial issue, nothing I can't handle on my own.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Do you need to inform the city guards?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: That would alarm Okhema's citizens. If they learn that the enemy can bypass the Chrysos Heirs and infiltrate the city, the situation might spiral out of control.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Is there anything you'd like us to help with?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: It's fine, Tribbie. As we discussed earlier, you need to prepare for the Blade of Fury.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: We got this! Don't exhaust yourself, Agy.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Don't exhaust yourself, Agy.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: (The nymphs have located the source of the disruption... I should check with the "Garmentmaker" for intel.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (Infiltration... {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} would never resort to this if they were in their right mind.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (What exactly led to their loss of divinity? The answer lies behind the fog... I hope Castorice and that outlander can uncover the truth.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Garmentmaker, can you give me the intel the nymphs have gathered?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (The lower city... It's good that the infiltration hasn't reached the baths yet. The risk remains manageable.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (The rift must be sewn shut with golden thread before disaster occurs.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: In the meantime...
Something wrong?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: What is this strange phenomenon...?
rows.speaker: Cautious Guard

rows.text: Should I report it to the captain?
rows.speaker: Cautious Guard

rows.text: ...Who goes there!?
rows.speaker: Cautious Guard

rows.text: L—Lady Aglaea! Wh—What brings you...
rows.speaker: Cautious Guard

rows.text: Corruption and madness are lurking behind these anomalies. I must deal with them myself to prevent further troubles.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: But I don't want to alarm the public. Can I trust you, honorable guard?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (Gently touch the girl's shoulder.)
(Run your fingertips through the girl's hair.)
(Hold out your arms.)
Aglaea extends her arm, signaling the girl to do the same.
Absolutely, Lady Aglaea! You have my solemn vow that none of this will come to light.
rows.speaker: Cautious Guard

rows.text: Thank you. If you don't mind, I will handle it from here.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: May {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#} bless you, Lady Aglaea.
rows.speaker: Cautious Guard

rows.text: (That young guard reads between the lines well. If the end weren't so near, he would have a bright future ahead of him.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (I'd better focus on the matter at hand first...)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: It's truly pathetic. A soldier stripped of all glory, lurking in the margins like a parasite.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Return to the dust, Titankin!
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (I need to ensure I leave no trace behind, so that no one suspects anything.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (Time to move on to the next nymph.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Caenis sneers and departs.
(If the enemy were to infiltrate from here, the damage could be catastrophic. I'd better deal with it at once...)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: O—Ouch! Watch where you're going, will you—
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: ...Bartholos?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: O—Oh, it's Lady Aglaea! Teehee, what a delight to see you here! Praise Phakele, every inch of your skin is glowing like the dawn itself!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: How can you still mix up the sky father's name? It's Kepha—
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...Never mind. I bet you did that on purpose. Tell me, Spirithief, why are you hiding in the filth?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Uh, it's... it's we're just trying to get rid of any threats to Okhema, haha!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: See? We turned this crazy stone monster inside into pieces with our spectacular skills, teehee!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Hmm... the traces of corruption have indeed disappeared.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: We would never dream of deceiving you, Lady Aglaea. In all of Okhema, you are the most revered—
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Save the smooth talk, Spirithief... I can tell you're feeling nervous.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: On second thought, since you're right here, I must ask you one more question: Where is Cipher?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Uh... There seems to be a misunderstanding, Lady Aglaea. Even though she and I work in the same trade, it doesn't make us allies!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: On the contrary, we're more like competitors! No competitor would want to cross paths with one another, teehee!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: ...Forget it. If you see her, let her know this: As demigods, we can't avoid our duties forever.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Alright, alright. Understood, Lady Aglaea! If there's nothing else, please excuse—
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Wait... if my suspicion is correct, are you skulking about in the filth to keep something hidden?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Return what you've stolen, and I'll let you go.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...Tsk! What rotten luck! Why did I have to bump into her...
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: O venerable {RUBY_B#Trickery Titan}Zagreus{RUBY_E#}, may I borrow a fragment of your fleetness?
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: I urge you—
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: How predictable... Did you truly think you could outrun me?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Teehee! It was worth a try, wasn't it?
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Got any more tricks up your sleeve? Let's see them all.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Argh, darn it! That was so close!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Go on, take it all! Help yourself to everything I've toiled for!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Well, you got me! Even if I starve to death, nobody in this city would so much as blink an eye at my plight!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Oh, you poor thing... But you don't actually need to eat at all, do you?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Y—You heartless woman! I never want to see you again, not for all the gold in the world!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Farewell, Bartholos. Be sure to get my message to Cipher.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (There's one more threat marked by the nymphs.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ({RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#}, sky father, I seek your guidance... May your hand keep all things in order.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Good day, child.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Filth, show yourself —
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Hundreds of resilient golden threads reach into the corrupted void, extracting the hidden malevolence within.
...Child?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (Tell me everything, child.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (M—My knucklebone talisman fell into this really frightening place...)
rows.speaker: Silent Girl

rows.text: (It's so dark and scary... I'm too afraid to reach in...)
rows.speaker: Silent Girl

rows.text: The girl beside you remains unresponsive.
(Oh... She's a child who can't hear.)
The golden thread gently wraps around the girl's palm... now their hearts are connected.
(Ah... I see. Don't worry, I'll help you find it.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (Just do me a little favor, okay? I want you to turn around and count to thirty.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Even a child's toy isn't safe from your grasp... Is greed one of your vices?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Return to the dust, wretch.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (Is this what you're looking for?)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: You retract the threads, ready to deal with the filth before you.
Show yourself, worm—
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Hundreds of resilient golden threads reach into the corrupted void, extracting the hidden malevolence within.
(Yes! That's it! Thank you, big sis!)
rows.speaker: Silent Girl

rows.text: (Big sis...)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (...Something on your mind, big sis?)
rows.speaker: Silent Girl

rows.text: (Nothing. But promise me you won't play on the streets alone from now on, even in Okhema.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (Your vulnerabilities will make you a target for others' malice. For many, it's easier to do wrong than to do good — believe me, I know from experience.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (Big sis, your words are so hard to understand. I'm really confused.)
rows.speaker: Silent Girl

rows.text: (...Sorry, it seems I've forgotten how to talk to a child. Your innocence feels so distant to me now.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (That's alright. I might not understand everything, but I still appreciate your advice. I'll be careful!)
rows.speaker: Silent Girl

rows.text: (Oh, and by the way, you look so pretty! Just like Goddess {RUBY_B#Romance Titan}Mnestia{RUBY_E#} on the teleslate — so shiny and sparkly! Your eyes are like two beautiful gems! I'm so jealous!)
rows.speaker: Silent Girl

rows.text: (I want you to have this knucklebone talisman, big sis. I hope it brings you luck every day and keeps you safe from bullies!)
rows.speaker: Silent Girl

rows.text: (...Thank you, child.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (All the filth marked by the nymphs has been cleansed.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: (I should go find teacher.)
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Hundreds of resilient golden threads reach into the corrupted void, extracting from within...
Show yourself now, before golden thread is stained with your blood.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Well, well, a demigod never ceases to impress. Not even a top assassin with a lifetime of "purging" experiences can slip past you.
rows.speaker: Elder Caenis

rows.text: What are you up to, Elder Caenis?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Drop the act. You noticed my informants a long time ago, didn't you?
rows.speaker: Elder Caenis

rows.text: You stayed silent to throw us off, so we'd let our guard down, while maintaining that everything you did abides by the Council's regulations — correct?
rows.speaker: Elder Caenis

rows.text: ...When it comes to schemes and manipulation, {RUBY_B#Trickery Titan}Zagreus{RUBY_E#} can't hold a candle to the Council.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Hehe, that's quite flattering, Chrysos Heir.
rows.speaker: Elder Caenis

rows.text: We bear no ill will. We just want to reiterate that the Chrysos Heirs' governance of the holy city is only temporary, a provisional transfer of authority during these extraordinary times.
rows.speaker: Elder Caenis

rows.text: While gods see and hear more extensively, mortals have their own means of dealing with things. When that so-called prophecy crumbles... the destiny of Okhema shall once again rest in the grasp of its people.
rows.speaker: Elder Caenis

rows.text: Rest in the grasp of its people... or yours, Elder Caenis?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Ease off on the hostility. You'd do well to remember nearly half of the elders stood against entrusting the holy city to you in that crucial vote. I am but one voice in the dissent.
rows.speaker: Elder Caenis

rows.text: Keep following your chosen path, demigod, use every bit of your power to show that we are mistaken... but don't forget for a second, in Amphoreus, even "gods" are not above the law.
rows.speaker: Elder Caenis

rows.text: I'm quite interested to see how long you can stick with this hands-on way of doing things... heh.
rows.speaker: Elder Caenis

rows.text: I will employ every means at my disposal to save Amphoreus, Elder Caenis. Whether it means wresting it from the grasp of the gods...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Or yours.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...Trinnon? It seems she has begun to make arrangements for defending Okhema.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...How can we go back to the past?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Come, follow!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Memory... Scent, strong!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: That battle cry... Is that Lord Mydei?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}... They're still locked in battle.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The battle is still raging... I can feel the intensity even from here.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I understand how you feel, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]. But right now, we must head to another battlefield.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Exactly. We'll only be able to help them once we've seen our own mission through.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: We'll only be able to help them once we've seen our own mission through.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Here, memory, complete. Give me, fragments.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Past... I, recreate.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Castrum Kremnos...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: So this is how it looked like before {RUBY_B#Sky Titan}Aquila{RUBY_E#} closed their eyes.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The City of Warriors, its magnificence certainly lives up to its name.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: We should first figure out which era we've traveled back to.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The memory fragments we gathered for Mem all point toward the final stage of the Chrysos War... We might be able to use that as a starting point for our deductions.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...We may draw suspicion this way. Castrum Kremnos is no leisure spot for tourists. We shouldn't draw unnecessary attention to ourselves.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: It's... quite intriguing, indeed. But Castrum Kremnos is no leisure spot for tourists. We shouldn't draw unnecessary attention to ourselves.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Let's start with the city's surroundings. We might be able to gather some clues by listening and observing.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Under all this resplendence... is the distinct stench of death.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: But even the most magnificent of deaths can never be sweet...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...What is it?
rows.speaker: Silent Gladiator

rows.text: War has left its mark on many from this period, so please don't take it personally...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Please wait, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]. It's best not to go there yet...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Let's try to find more clues around here first.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...He was killed by Lord Mydei.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: No... I don't believe that Lord Mydei left out of cowardice. It was, in fact, a courageous choice.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: They are entitled to that rage... because Lord Mydei was once the hero of Castrum Kremnos.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: With that, we should have enough to determine the time period we are currently in.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: It's a scroll written in the common tongue. We should see what it's about.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Courage, Honor, Reason, Tenacity, Sacrifice...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} did live up to these values in their prime, but now...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Kremnos seems to be hosting a festival, where its victor can go on to have an audience with the ruler and be bestowed with honor. It's just as Mr. Damionis described.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: If we can pose as participants, we might be able to get into the city...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Gladiator swords, maces, and bucklers crafted by the Grand Craftsman Chartonus himself!
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: Looking to breeze through your foes at the Kremnos Festival? I've got the best weapons right here for you!
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: Not getting much business, huh?
Are these really crafted by Chartonus?
Hmph... Those boorish warriors know nothing about quality gear!
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: I'm as honest a merchant as they come! Those boorish warriors know nothing about quality gear!
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: Ah, but you're not like them! With your air of sophistication, you must be a noble from one of the grand city-states, right? Here, let me show you what I have in stock...
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: (Look at Castorice.)
Could this be a scam?
The Sword of the Soul-Forging Statue failed to return to its original place. Something is still missing here.
Perhaps you should try using the Hand of Zagreus to restore the statue's base.
The Sword of the Soul-Forging Statue failed to return to its original place. Something is still missing here. Upon close inspection, you notice the body of the statue is incomplete.
Perhaps you should try using the Oronyx Orb to reflect its whole body.
The craftsmanship of a weapon reveals the time period it's made... We can afford to take a quick look.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I have no clue, what can I do? (Skip puzzle)
No worries, let me ponder on it a bit more...
{M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]... Much as we're in a memory of the past, impulse buying is still an undesirable behavior.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Phainon steers his own fate.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: If he can conquer his fear and return as a demigod, we will be one step closer to the miracle that the prophecy promised.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Wahaha, you're quite the high-roller! Thank you, and please come again!
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: May I take a look at that weapon, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...That would mean his time hasn't come yet. And that there is a more arduous mission for him to see through.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: You must have noticed by now. Every Chrysos Heir here bears... a flaw of sorts. Be it the curse of immortality, or the constant erosion of their humanity, or...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: But not Phainon. He is a Chrysos Heir without flaw, a perfect vessel for divinity.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: There will come a day when he leads everyone — everyone we have left — through the gates of the miracle.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Phainon steers his own fate.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: There will come a day when he leads everyone — everyone we have left — through the gates of the miracle.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Zzz... Zzz...
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: Looks like she fell asleep. Presiding over this ritual must take quite a toll.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Snowy... zzz... will succeed...
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: Zzz... Zzz...
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: Snowy... zzz... will succeed...
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: I pray you truly are prepared, Lord Phainon.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I thought you'd be the kind to make impulsive purchases, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss.} [Trailblazer], but you've certainly proven me wrong.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Tsk. So you're just window shopping? What a waste of my time...
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: I spoke at length with Lord Phainon before. There was hesitation in his words.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Yes, there was hesitation in his words.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The manifestation of the prophecy must have seen this. It saw Lord Phainon's heart wavering.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Wherever he is, whatever he is fighting, I pray he makes it through this test.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Mister, can I please have a look at the weapon you're holding on to?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Oh? A gentle lady like you taking an interest in weapons? Why, of course! Please, feel free to take a closer look!
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: ...I've seen enough. Let's go, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss.} [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Leaving already? Don't you want to browse through my other wares?
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: Well then, come back anytime... if you make it through the festival today.
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: The three of you rush into Castrum Kremnos and arrive at the arena
Those weapons reek of blood. He made an effort to conceal it, but traces of death aren't something you can easily erase... I shudder to even consider where he got his goods from.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: He didn't lie about the weapon being one of Chartonus' handiwork, though. Thanks to its inscription, I now have a fairly good guess of the time period we're in.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Let's run through everything we know so far, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Lord Mydei has gone to seek refuge in Okhema with some of his people. Old King Eurypon still reigns, though {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} has fallen into a slumber. And Castrum Kremnos is now gathering warriors from all over in preparation for their festival...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: It seems that we've traveled back to the last years of the Chrysos War, a time when Castrum Kremnos grappled with both internal strife and the Titan's waning divinity.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: That's too risky of a plan. And I might even become a burden to you.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I... can't control my strength with that much precision, the risk is too great.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: The safest bet is to play by the rules. They happen to be hosting a festival in the city... We can try entering as participants?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Let's make our way into the city first, we can then wait for the right opportunity to strike. When it comes down to it... I will take care of {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}'s kin.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: That should be the place to sign up.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...Such a pity! Those three warriors were so close to completing the trial, to emerging as victorious Kremnoan warriors, and to earning an audience with our glorious King Eurypon!
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: And yet, they collapsed at the final hurdle! The Furiae Praetor swiftly hacked them down, reducing them to mere mincemeat... May {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} recognize their valor and embrace their heroic spirits.
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: ...Next! Do we have any more warriors ready for the challenge? King Eurypon awaits, longing for the first brave soul to survive and stand before him!
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: This was a time when life was valued far less than bread. People hardly bat their eyelids at the savagery and death that had become commonplace.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Does no one have the courage to take up the challenge? Are you not prepared to wager your glory and set your lives ablaze under the splendor of Kremnos?
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: Hmph, so you're not just inarticulate, but also hard of hearing... Keep up this act of nuisance, and I'll be sure to show you how uncivil we can get!
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: Teams of three...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer], this might be our chance...! We can enter the city with him.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Hm? Who are...
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: ...You two.
rows.speaker: Silent Gladiator

rows.text: Pfft... I see what this is.
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: As you wish! Good for you, you now have allies to court death with. Come on up here, fool!
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: The adrenaline-pumping scenes are becoming a bit tiresome, so adding a wildly mismatched "interlude" would make for a refreshing change and spice things up.
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: Let the trial begin, then! Your only goal is to survive! As long as you still hold the breath of life, you'll either triumph over every trial and claim worldly glory — or leave your soul in Kremnos to become fuel for Strife!
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: Have faith, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]... Lord Phainon and Lord Mydei are still fighting. We must match their unwavering resolve.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...Can we enter now?
rows.speaker: Silent Gladiator

rows.text: Eager to meet your demise? Very well then, let the trial begin!
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: Give me your names, warriors.
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: Castorice, Gnaeus, and [Trailblazer]...
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: Galactic Baseballer, Castorice, and Gnaeus...
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: It is an honor to see your true faces revealed by the radiant glow of The Blade of Fury.
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: In the name of the five virtues of {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} — courage, honor, reason, tenacity, and sacrifice — stride through the holy city's gate and embrace your fate.
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: In the name of the five virtues of {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#}, stride through the holy city's gate and embrace your fate.
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: Lord Gnaeus, may I ask what is it you are fighting for?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Fighting needs no reason. I seek only to crush foolishness.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Finest weapons for sale! Come take a look! The sharpest blades in all of Kremnos!
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: They have fewer guards than I expected. I thought we'd be greeted with something more... intense.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Meaningless...
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Not getting much business, huh?
Why stall those charging for Death's door?
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Are these really crafted by Chartonus?
Death is not part of our plan, Lord Gnaeus. We should work on solving the puzzle they've set for us.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Look, there are two braziers on that wall. Could they be... some sort of hint?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: (Look at Castorice.)
And those mechanisms protruding from the ground... Should we attempt to activate them?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Could this be a scam?
A Prophecy Tablet...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Let's make use of the tools here to solve the puzzle.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Rest in peace...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: A dreamless sleep is nothing but deathly silence.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Is this the exit? Oh, it's locked.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Let's focus on igniting the braziers first.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Oronyx{RUBY_E#}...
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Finest weapons for sale! Come take a look! The sharpest blades in all of Kremnos!
rows.speaker: Weapon Merchant

rows.text: What's wrong, Lord Gnaeus?
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: May your courageous souls satisfy {RUBY_B#Strife Titan}Nikador{RUBY_E#} and fuel the conquests of Kremnos.
rows.speaker: Kremnos Registration Officer

rows.text: Weak. Reduced to a servant of humans.
rows.speaker: Gnaeus

rows.text: Barricades... We must find a way to remove them.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Could it be a challenge that requires us to use the Hand of Zagreus? Let's get closer and find out.
rows.speaker: Castorice
